return function()

 local checks=0

 local function check(ok,message) checks+=1 assert(ok,message) end

 local function series(n,interval)

  local c={} for i=1,n do local o=100+math.sin(i/7)*5 c[i]={Time=(i-1)*(interval or 60),Open=o,High=o+2,Low=o-2,Close=o+(i%3==0 and -1 or 1),Volume=i} end return c

 end

 local candles=series(700)

 -- Deep zoom-out is limited by history and by plot width (7 px per candle).

 local minBars,maxBars=V.Limits(#candles,1266)

 check(minBars==10 and maxBars==math.floor(1266/7),"700 candles: zoom-out respects readable spacing: "..maxBars)

 local _,wide=V.Limits(1440,1266) check(wide==math.floor(1266/7),"Long history: zoom-out is limited by plot width at 7 px per candle: "..wide)

 local _,narrow=V.Limits(1440,500) check(narrow==math.floor(500/7),"Narrow plots still allow readable spacing")

 local _,cap=V.Limits(5000,4000) check(cap==V.MaxBars,"Absolute render ceiling")

 local _,small=V.Limits(30,1266) check(small==math.max(40,math.ceil(30*1.15)+5),"Zoom limits follow available history")

 local state={} local live=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(live.Live and live.Follow and #live.Data<#candles,"Starts following live with a navigable window")

 for _=1,40 do V.Zoom(state,live,1.4,0.5) live=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266) end

 check(live.Bars==maxBars,"Zoom out reaches the practical limit and stops")

 check(live.Right<=candles[#candles].Time+V.RightMargin*60+1e-6 and #live.Data<=maxBars+3 and live.Interval==60,"Zoom keeps real one-minute candles and a bounded readable count")

 for _=1,40 do V.Zoom(state,live,0.5,0.5) live=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266) end

 check(live.Bars==minBars,"Zoom in stops at the minimum")

 -- Cursor-anchored zoom keeps the time under the pointer fixed (away from bounds).

 V.Reset(state) local v=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 V.Pan(state,v,400,0,1266,300) v=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 for _,f in ipairs({0.1,0.37,0.8})do

  local anchor=V.TimeAt(v,f) V.Zoom(state,v,1.3,f) local z=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

  check(math.abs(V.TimeAt(z,f)-anchor)<1e-6,"Zoom out keeps the pointer's time at "..f)

  anchor=V.TimeAt(z,f) V.Zoom(state,z,0.7,f) v=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

  check(math.abs(V.TimeAt(v,f)-anchor)<1e-6,"Zoom in keeps the pointer's time at "..f)

 end

 -- Detached viewport is preserved when candles arrive; following scrolls with them.

 check(not v.Follow,"Panning into history stops following")

 local right,low=v.Right,v.Low

 local grown=table.clone(candles) table.insert(grown,{Time=700*60,Open=100,High=130,Low=90,Close=120,Volume=5})

 local after=V.Resolve(state,grown,"1m",0.25,false,{120},1266)

 check(after.Right==right and after.Bars==v.Bars,"New candles do not move a detached viewport")

 local follow={} local f1=V.Resolve(follow,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 local f2=V.Resolve(follow,grown,"1m",0.25,false,{120},1266)

 check(f2.Right-f1.Right==60 and f2.Follow,"Following scrolls by exactly the new candle")

 -- Auto-fit pan moves time only; manual scale pans price too.

 local pan={} local p0=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 V.Pan(pan,p0,100,80,1266,300) local p1=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(p1.AutoY and p1.Right<p0.Right,"Auto-fit drag pans time and keeps auto scale")

 -- Y-axis drag: up = taller candles (narrower range), down = shorter; persists until auto-fit.

 V.ScalePrice(pan,p1,-60,300) local tall=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(not tall.AutoY and tall.High-tall.Low<p1.High-p1.Low,"Dragging the axis up compresses the range")

 V.Pan(pan,tall,-30,40,1266,300) local moved=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(math.abs((moved.High-moved.Low)-(tall.High-tall.Low))<1e-9 and moved.Low>tall.Low,"Manual scale survives panning and pans price")

 local grown2=table.clone(candles) table.insert(grown2,{Time=700*60,Open=100,High=400,Low=10,Close=120,Volume=5})

 local still=V.Resolve(pan,grown2,"1m",0.25,false,{120},1266)

 check(still.Low==moved.Low and still.High==moved.High,"Manual scale persists across live updates")

 V.ScalePrice(pan,moved,80,300) local short=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(short.High-short.Low>moved.High-moved.Low,"Dragging the axis down expands the range")

 V.AutoFit(pan) local fitted=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(fitted.AutoY and fitted.Low==short.Low,"Auto-fit starts from the current scale")

 for _=1,200 do V.Ease(pan,1/60) end fitted=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(math.abs(fitted.Low-fitted.TargetLow)<1e-9 and math.abs(fitted.High-fitted.TargetHigh)<1e-9,"Auto-fit settles exactly on the visible candles")

 local lo,hi=math.huge,-math.huge

 for _,c in ipairs(fitted.Data)do if c.Time>=fitted.Left-30 and c.Time<=fitted.Right+30 then lo=math.min(lo,c.Low) hi=math.max(hi,c.High)end end

 check(fitted.Low<lo and fitted.High>hi,"Auto-fit contains every visible candle")

 -- Go to live keeps the zoom; reset restores defaults.

 V.Zoom(pan,fitted,1.5,0.5) local zoomed=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 V.Pan(pan,zoomed,600,0,1266,300) zoomed=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 V.GoLive(pan,101) local back=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(back.Follow and back.Bars==zoomed.Bars and back.Right==candles[#candles].Time+V.RightMargin*60,"Go to live keeps zoom and follows")

 V.Reset(pan) local reset=V.Resolve(pan,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266)

 check(reset.Bars==V.DefaultBars.Desktop and reset.Live,"Reset view restores default zoom, auto-fit and live")

 -- Pinch keeps the time under the start midpoint under the current midpoint.

 local pinch={} local pv=V.Resolve(pinch,candles,"1m",0.25,true,{101},360)

 local anchor=V.TimeAt(pv,0.4) V.Pinch(pinch,pv,0.4,0.55,0.6,0,200)

 local pz=V.Resolve(pinch,candles,"1m",0.25,true,{101},360)

 check(math.abs(V.TimeAt(pz,0.55)-anchor)<1e-6 and pz.Bars<pv.Bars,"Pinch zoom anchors to the midpoint")

 -- Bounds and degenerate data.

 V.Pan(state,v,-1e8,0,1266,300) local b=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266) check(b.Right<=b.Maximum,"Right bound")

 V.Pan(state,b,1e8,0,1266,300) b=V.Resolve(state,candles,"1m",0.25,false,{101},1266) check(b.Right>=b.Minimum and #b.Data>0,"Left bound keeps candles visible")

 local one=V.Resolve({},{{Time=0,Open=100,High=100,Low=100,Close=100,Volume=1}},"1D",0.25,false,{100},500)

 check(one.High>one.Low and one.Right>one.Left,"Single flat candle has a valid view")

 -- Ticks are round multiples of the tick size and inside the range.

 local ticks,step=V.PriceTicks(5801.3,5843.9,0.25,6)

 check(step%0.25==0 and #ticks>=3 and ticks[1]>=5801.3 and ticks[#ticks]<=5843.9,"Price ticks")

 for _,t in ipairs(ticks)do check(math.abs(t/step-math.round(t/step))<1e-6,"Price ticks are aligned") end

 local tt,ts=V.TimeTicks(3000,9000,60,6) check(ts>=60 and tt[1]%ts==0,"Time ticks aligned")

 check(candles[1].Time==0 and candles[700].Time==699*60,"Navigation never mutates candles")

 return {Passed=true,Cases=checks,Checks="Zoom limits, cursor/pinch anchoring, follow vs detached, auto-fit pan, manual Y scale, auto-fit easing, go live, reset, bounds, ticks"}

end
ServerScriptService.MarketReign.Particip:
-- One deterministic scheduler; participants never own task loops or modify trade prices.
local Participants={}
Participants.__index=Participants
local RNG={} RNG.__index=RNG
function RNG.new(seed) return setmetatable({State=math.floor(math.abs(seed))%2147483646+1},RNG) end
function RNG:Next() self.State=self.State*48271%2147483647 return self.State/2147483647 end
function RNG:Range(a,b) return a+(b-a)*self:Next() end
function RNG:Int(a,b) return math.floor(self:Range(a,b+1)) end
function RNG:Noise() return (self:Next()+self:Next()+self:Next()-1.5)*2 end
Participants.RNG=RNG
function Participants.new(engine)
 local self=setmetatable({Engine=engine,Config=engine.Config,Random=RNG.new(engine.Seed),Agents={},Markets={},Regime=nil,
  NextRegime=0,NextNews=80,NextBeliefs=0,News="No synthetic news",NewsUntil=0,Events={}},Participants)
 local r=self.Random
 self:_regime()
 for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
  local book=engine.Books[key]
  self.Markets[key]={Fair=book.Reference,Anchor=book.Reference,Impulse=0}
  for i=1,self.Config.MakersPerInstrument do self:_agent(key,"Maker",i) end
  for i=1,self.Config.ParticipantsPerInstrument do
   local total=0 for _,kind in ipairs({"Liquidity","Momentum","Value","Reversion","Protective"}) do total+=self.Config.BehaviorWeights[kind] or 0 end
   local draw=r:Range(0,total) local chosen="Liquidity"
   for _,kind in ipairs({"Liquidity","Momentum","Value","Reversion","Protective"}) do draw-=self.Config.BehaviorWeights[kind] or 0 if draw<=0 then chosen=kind break end end
   self:_agent(key,chosen,i)
  end
  if self.Config.WhaleFrequency>0 then for i=1,self.Config.WhalesPerInstrument do self:_agent(key,"Whale",i) end end
 end
 -- A genuine opening auction: finite makers post, and a participant crosses a quote.
 for _,a in ipairs(self.Agents) do if a.Kind=="Maker" then self:_maker(a) end end
 for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
  for _,a in ipairs(self.Agents) do if a.Key==key and a.Kind~="Maker" then
   engine:Submit(a.Id,{Contract=key,Direction=r:Next()<0.5 and 1 or -1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"}) break
  end end
 end
 return self
end
function Participants:_agent(key,kind,index)
 local r=self.Random local maker=kind=="Maker" local whale=kind=="Whale"
 local id="bot:"..key..":"..kind..":"..index
 local budget=r:Int(maker and 350000 or whale and 600000 or 50000,maker and 650000 or whale and 1100000 or 160000)
 local a={Id=id,Key=key,Kind=kind,Budget=budget,Risk=r:Range(0.45,0.85),Limit=r:Int(maker and 140 or whale and 180 or 16,maker and 250 or whale and 350 or 60),
  Speed=r:Range(maker and 1.5 or whale and 28 or 2.5,maker and 4.5 or whale and 100 or 13),Size=r:Int(maker and 3 or whale and 18 or 1,maker and 9 or whale and 60 or 5),
  Bias=r:Range(-0.55,0.55),Belief=self.Markets[key].Fair+r:Noise()*9,Patience=r:Range(4,35),Aggression=r:Range(0.2,0.8),
  Next=r:Range(0.2,18),Stop=r:Int(16,85),Target=r:Int(20,140),Parent=0,ParentSide=1}
 if whale then a.Bias=index%2==0 and -0.3 or 0.3 end
 self.Engine:AddAccount(id,budget,a.Limit,a.Risk,false) table.insert(self.Agents,a)
end
-- Add a new market on migration without reseeding or advancing the saved exchange.
-- Retired (close-only) books keep their original participants and economics until positions close.
function Participants:AddMarket(key)
 local e=self.Engine local r=self.Random local first=#self.Agents+1
 local book=e.Books[key]
 self.Markets[key]={Fair=book.Reference,Anchor=book.Reference,Impulse=0}
 for i=1,self.Config.MakersPerInstrument do self:_agent(key,"Maker",i) end
 for i=1,self.Config.ParticipantsPerInstrument do
  local total=0 for _,kind in ipairs({"Liquidity","Momentum","Value","Reversion","Protective"}) do total+=self.Config.BehaviorWeights[kind] or 0 end
  local draw=r:Range(0,total) local chosen="Liquidity"
  for _,kind in ipairs({"Liquidity","Momentum","Value","Reversion","Protective"}) do draw-=self.Config.BehaviorWeights[kind] or 0 if draw<=0 then chosen=kind break end end
  self:_agent(key,chosen,i)
 end
 if self.Config.WhaleFrequency>0 then for i=1,self.Config.WhalesPerInstrument do self:_agent(key,"Whale",i) end end
 for i=first,#self.Agents do
  local a=self.Agents[i] a.Next+=e.Time
  if a.Kind=="Maker" then self:_maker(a) end
 end
 for i=first,#self.Agents do
  local a=self.Agents[i]
  if a.Kind~="Maker" then e:Submit(a.Id,{Contract=key,Direction=r:Next()<0.5 and 1 or -1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"}) break end
 end
end
function Participants:_regime()
 local r=self.Random local total=0 for _,regime in ipairs(self.Config.Regimes) do total+=regime.Weight end
 local draw=r:Range(0,total) local chosen=self.Config.Regimes[1]
 for _,regime in ipairs(self.Config.Regimes) do draw-=regime.Weight if draw<=0 then chosen=regime break end end
 self.Regime=chosen self.Direction=r:Next()<0.5 and 1 or -1
 self.NextRegime=self.Engine.Time+r:Range(self.Config.RegimeSeconds[1],self.Config.RegimeSeconds[2])
 table.insert(self.Events,{Step=self.Engine.Step,Kind="Regime",Name=chosen.Name,Direction=self.Direction})
 if #self.Events>40 then table.remove(self.Events,1) end
end
function Participants:_maker(a)
 local e=self.Engine local b=e.Books[a.Key] local r=self.Random local c=b.Spec local market=self.Markets[a.Key]
 e:CancelAll(a.Id,a.Key)
 local account=e.Accounts[a.Id] if account.Locked then return end
 local p=account.Positions[a.Key] local inventory=p and p.Quantity*p.Direction or 0
 local stress=self.Regime.Volatility*self.Config.Volatility+math.min(6,b.Volatility)*0.2
 local center=(b.Last or b.Reference)*0.83+market.Fair*0.17-inventory/a.Limit*(5+stress*5)+r:Noise()*0.7
 local spread=math.max(1,math.floor(stress*0.8+b.Volatility*0.2+r:Range(0,1.4)))
 local liquidity=self.Regime.Liquidity*self.Config.Liquidity
 if self.Engine.Time<self.NewsUntil then liquidity*=0.6 end
 if r:Next()>math.min(1,liquidity*1.7) then return end
 for depth=1,3 do
  for _,side in ipairs({1,-1}) do
   local size=math.max(1,math.floor(a.Size*liquidity*r:Range(0.55,1.25)*(1-inventory/a.Limit*side*0.8)))
   local tick=math.max(1,math.round(center-side*(spread+(depth-1)*math.max(1,math.floor(stress)))))
   e:Submit(a.Id,{Contract=a.Key,Direction=side,Quantity=size,Type="Limit",Price=tick*c.Tick,Expires=e.Time+a.Speed*2.8})
  end
 end
end
function Participants:_trader(a)
 local e=self.Engine local b=e.Books[a.Key] local r=self.Random local c=b.Spec
 local account=e.Accounts[a.Id] if account.Locked then return end
 if r:Next()<0.25 then return end -- varied inactivity, even around news
 local last=b.Last or b.Reference local market=self.Markets[a.Key]
 a.Belief+=(market.Fair-a.Belief)*r:Range(0.02,0.18)+r:Noise()*self.Regime.Volatility*c.Scale*0.6
 local p=account.Positions[a.Key] local inventory=p and p.Quantity*p.Direction or 0
 local recent=b.Recent local previous=recent[math.max(1,#recent-r:Int(8,35))] or last
 local momentum=(last-previous)/math.max(3,b.Volatility*8)
 local edge=(a.Belief-last)/math.max(4,b.Volatility*8)
 local signal=a.Bias+r:Noise()*1.3-inventory/a.Limit*1.8
 if a.Kind=="Momentum" then signal+=momentum*r:Range(0.5,1.4)
 elseif a.Kind=="Value" then signal+=edge*r:Range(0.6,1.5)
 elseif a.Kind=="Reversion" then signal-=momentum*r:Range(0.6,1.6) signal+=edge*0.3
 elseif a.Kind=="Protective" then signal+=edge*0.4 end
 if math.abs(signal)<r:Range(0.1,0.55) then return end
 local side=signal>0 and 1 or -1 local size=r:Int(1,a.Size)
 local aggressive=r:Next()<a.Aggression
 if a.Kind=="Whale" then
  if a.Parent>0 then side=a.ParentSide size=math.min(a.Parent,r:Int(4,math.max(5,math.floor(a.Size/3)))) a.Parent-=size
  else
   size=r:Int(math.floor(a.Size/2),a.Size)
   if r:Next()<0.55 then a.Parent=size*r:Int(2,4) a.ParentSide=side size=math.min(a.Parent,r:Int(4,12)) a.Parent-=size end
  end
  aggressive=r:Next()<0.8
 end
 if r:Next()<0.45 then e:CancelAll(a.Id,a.Key) end
 local request={Contract=a.Key,Direction=side,Quantity=size,Type=aggressive and "Market" or "Limit",Expires=e.Time+a.Patience*r:Range(0.5,1.5)}
 if not aggressive then
  local distance=r:Int(1,math.max(2,math.floor(3+self.Regime.Volatility*3)))
  request.Price=math.max(1,math.round(last-side*distance))*c.Tick
 end
 if a.Kind=="Protective" or (a.Kind~="Maker" and r:Next()<0.16) then request.StopTicks=a.Stop request.TargetTicks=a.Target end
 e:Submit(a.Id,request)
end
function Participants:Step()
 local e=self.Engine local r=self.Random
 e:AdvanceClock(self.Config.StepSeconds)
 if e.Time>=self.NextRegime then self:_regime() end
 if self.Config.NewsFrequency>0 and e.Time>=self.NextNews then
  local sign=r:Next()<0.5 and 1 or -1
  local magnitude=r:Range(8,40)*self.Config.Volatility
  for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
   local m=self.Markets[key] local shock=sign*magnitude*e.Books[key].Spec.Scale*r:Range(0.4,1.5)
   m.Anchor+=shock m.Impulse+=shock*0.1
  end
  self.News=(sign>0 and "Optimistic" or "Cautious").." synthetic outlook"
  self.NewsUntil=e.Time+r:Range(20,55) self.NextNews=e.Time+r:Range(140,420)/self.Config.NewsFrequency
  table.insert(self.Events,{Step=e.Step,Kind="News",Name=self.News,Direction=sign}) if #self.Events>40 then table.remove(self.Events,1) end
 end
 if e.Time>=self.NextBeliefs then
  for _,key in ipairs(self.Config.ContractOrder) do
   local m=self.Markets[key] local c=e.Books[key].Spec
   m.Anchor+=self.Regime.Trend*self.Direction*c.Scale+r:Noise()*self.Regime.Volatility*self.Config.Volatility*c.Scale*0.16
   m.Fair+=(m.Anchor-m.Fair)*0.025+m.Impulse*0.06
   m.Impulse*=0.96
   m.Fair=math.clamp(m.Fair,e.Books[key].Reference*0.6,e.Books[key].Reference*1.4)
  end
  self.NextBeliefs=e.Time+1
 end
 for _,a in ipairs(self.Agents) do
  if e.Time>=a.Next then
   if a.Kind=="Maker" then self:_maker(a) else self:_trader(a) end
   local delay=a.Speed*r:Range(0.45,1.65)/self.Regime.Activity
   if a.Kind=="Whale" then delay=a.Parent>0 and r:Range(1.5,6) or delay/math.max(0.0001,self.Config.WhaleFrequency) end
   a.Next=e.Time+delay
   e:ProcessStops()
  end
 end
end
return Participants

-- Server-only storage and ownership settings. Never copy a live checkpoint into ReplicatedStorage.
return {
 Enabled=true,
 StoreName="MarketReign_Continuous_v1",
 WorldKey="primary-exchange",
 LeaseSeconds=90,
 SafetySeconds=15,
 SaveSeconds=15,
 RetrySeconds=5,
 -- Checkpoint size limits, checked before every commit (a refused save pauses trading; the last save stays).
 -- Raw JSON: the writer refuses exactly what the reader refuses (WorldCheckpoint.MaxDecodedBytes, 32,000,000),
 -- so every checkpoint that can be saved can be restored, and every save that restores today can be saved again.
 -- MaxEncodedBytes bounds the WHOLE stored DataStore value (lease fields + compressed checkpoint) plus
 -- RecordHeadroomBytes, below Roblox's 4,194,304-character value limit (the JSON-encoded length). It is above the previous 3,500,000 check
 -- on the checkpoint alone, so no save the previous build accepted can become unsavable after this update.
 MaxEncodedBytes=3600000,
 RecordHeadroomBytes=4096,
 -- Growth headroom. New profiles and free restarts pause once the last saved checkpoint used
 -- CapacityFraction of either limit; a first Start can use the band up to
 -- NewAccountCapacityFraction. Existing accounts keep trading throughout; nothing is deleted.
 CapacityFraction=0.8,
 NewAccountCapacityFraction=0.9,
 -- Per-connection acknowledgement queue. Replies wait for the player's next market packet; a client that
 -- never subscribes keeps at most MaxQueuedReplies, each for at most ReplyMaxAgeSeconds. Dropped replies
 -- force a full state resync on the next packet.
 MaxQueuedReplies=64,
 ReplyMaxAgeSeconds=30,
 -- Unpublished Studio files cannot use Roblox persistence. Keep an explicitly labelled local sandbox.
 AllowUnsavedStudio=true,
 StudioReplaySeed=0, -- A positive value replays a NEW Studio world only; live servers always seed privately.
}

-- Reply queue and empty-book pricing regressions. Disposable engines only.
local Tests={}
local C=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.MarketConfig)
local L=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.ProgressionConfig)
local E=require(script.Parent.MarketEngine)
local F=require(script.Parent.FundedAccounts)
local Settings=require(script.Parent.WorldConfig)
local ReplyBuffer=require(script.Parent.ReplyBuffer)
local function clone(v) if type(v)~="table" then return v end local r={} for k,x in pairs(v) do r[k]=clone(x) end return r end
local function equal(a,b,label) assert(a==b,(label or "value")..": "..tostring(a).." ~= "..tostring(b)) end
local function exchange(l,uid,options)
 local c=clone(C);c.WarmupSeconds=0
 local e=E.new(c,4821);local f=F.new(e,l or L,c,options)
 if uid then assert(f:Start(uid)) end
 return e,f
end

function Tests.Run()
 local report={}
 local function test(name,fn)local ok,value=pcall(fn);table.insert(report,{Name=name,Passed=ok,Detail=ok and (value or "Passed") or tostring(value)})end
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ F3 replies
 test("F3: reply queues stay bounded by count and age for clients that never subscribe",function()
  local buffer=ReplyBuffer.new(Settings.MaxQueuedReplies,Settings.ReplyMaxAgeSeconds)
  local state={Replies={},ReplyTimes={}};local now=0
  for i=1,10000 do
   now+=1/6 -- the remote limiter's sustained rate
   local kind=i%3==0 and {RequestId=i,Ok=false,Message="Exchange busy. Please retry."} or i%3==1 and {RequestId=i,Ok=true,Message="Saved.",Kind="Start"} or {RequestId=i,Ok=false,Message="Rejected"}
   buffer:Push(state,kind,now)
   assert(#state.Replies<=Settings.MaxQueuedReplies and #state.ReplyTimes==#state.Replies,"reply queue exceeded its bound")
  end
  equal(#state.Replies,Settings.MaxQueuedReplies);assert(state.Full and state.DroppedReplies==10000-Settings.MaxQueuedReplies)
  equal(state.Replies[#state.Replies].RequestId,10000,"newest reply kept");equal(state.Replies[1].RequestId,10000-Settings.MaxQueuedReplies+1)
  local queued,dropped=buffer:Take(state);equal(#queued,Settings.MaxQueuedReplies);equal(dropped,10000-Settings.MaxQueuedReplies)
  equal(#state.Replies,0);equal(state.DroppedReplies,nil)
  -- Age bound: idle connections release everything after ReplyMaxAgeSeconds.
  state.Full=false
  for i=1,5 do buffer:Push(state,{RequestId=i,Ok=true},now) end
  buffer:Prune(state,now+Settings.ReplyMaxAgeSeconds);equal(#state.Replies,5,"not yet expired")
  buffer:Prune(state,now+Settings.ReplyMaxAgeSeconds+0.01);equal(#state.Replies,0);assert(state.Full,"expiry forces a full resync")
  local _,expired=buffer:Take(state);equal(expired,5)
  -- A normally subscribed client (flushed every broadcast) never loses a reply.
  local live={Replies={},ReplyTimes={}}
  for i=1,200 do buffer:Push(live,{RequestId=i},i*0.1);if i%1==0 then local got,lost=buffer:Take(live);equal(#got,1);equal(lost,nil) end end
 end)

 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ S1 pricing
 test("S1: empty-side fallback quotes never cross; long and short round trips cannot profit",function()
  local function book() local e,f=exchange(nil,"q1");e:AddAccount("maker",1000000,500,.8,false);return e,f,e.Books.BX end
  -- Long: asks empty, a participant bid one tick above the last trade.
  local e,f,b=book();local id=f:Owner("q1");local tick=b.Spec.Tick
  local last=(b.Last or b.Reference)
  assert(e:Submit("maker",{Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=10,Type="Limit",Price=(last+1)*tick}))
  assert(#b.Asks==0 and b.Bids[1].Price>last)
  local start=e.Accounts[id].Balance
  for _=1,10 do
   local ok,fill=F.Perform(e,id,{Action="Place",Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=5,Type="Market"});assert(ok and fill.Filled==5)
   assert(fill.Average>=b.Bids[1].Price*tick,"buy filled below the best bid")
   assert(F.Perform(e,id,{Action="Close",Contract="BX"}))
  end
  assert(e.Accounts[id].Balance<=start+1e-9,"long round trips profited: "..(e.Accounts[id].Balance-start))
  assert(f:Profile("q1").WalletCents==nil,"Wallet returned")
  -- A marketable buy limit below the clamped fallback no longer fills at the lower last trade.
  local ok,rest=F.Perform(e,id,{Action="Place",Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Limit",Price=last*tick})
  assert(ok and rest.Filled==0 and rest.Remaining==1,"limit filled through the bid");e:Cancel(id,rest.Id)
  e:Audit()
  -- Short: bids empty, a participant ask one tick below the last trade.
  local e2,f2,b2=book();local id2=f2:Owner("q1");local last2=(b2.Last or b2.Reference)
  assert(e2:Submit("maker",{Contract="BX",Direction=-1,Quantity=10,Type="Limit",Price=(last2-1)*tick}))
  assert(#b2.Bids==0 and b2.Asks[1].Price<last2)
  local start2=e2.Accounts[id2].Balance
  for _=1,10 do
   local okShort,fill=F.Perform(e2,id2,{Action="Place",Contract="BX",Direction=-1,Quantity=5,Type="Market"});assert(okShort and fill.Filled==5)
   assert(fill.Average<=b2.Asks[1].Price*tick,"sell filled above the best ask")
   assert(F.Perform(e2,id2,{Action="Close",Contract="BX"}))
  end
  assert(e2.Accounts[id2].Balance<=start2+1e-9,"short round trips profited: "..(e2.Accounts[id2].Balance-start2))
  e2:Audit()
  -- No liquidity at all: closes and depletion liquidation still fill at the last trade.
  local e3,f3=exchange(nil,"q3");local id3=f3:Owner("q3");local b3=e3.Books.BX;b3.Bids={};b3.Asks={};b3.Last=24000
  assert(F.Perform(e3,id3,{Action="Place",Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=3,Type="Market"}))
  b3.Last=24000-5000/50/b3.Spec.Tick;e3:AdvanceClock(.25)
  assert(e3.Accounts[id3].Locked and not e3.Accounts[id3].Positions.BX,"liquidation stuck without liquidity")
  e3:Audit()
  -- Two-sided book: normal fills are unchanged (buy at the ask, sell at the bid).
  local e4,f4,b4=book();local id4=f4:Owner("q1");local l4=b4.Last or b4.Reference
  assert(e4:Submit("maker",{Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=5,Type="Limit",Price=(l4-2)*tick}))
  e4:AddAccount("maker2",1000000,500,.8,false)
  assert(e4:Submit("maker2",{Contract="BX",Direction=-1,Quantity=5,Type="Limit",Price=(l4+2)*tick}))
  local _,buy=F.Perform(e4,id4,{Action="Place",Contract="BX",Direction=1,Quantity=1,Type="Market"});equal(buy.Average,(l4+2)*tick,"buy at ask")
  local _,sell=F.Perform(e4,id4,{Action="Close",Contract="BX"});equal(sell.Average,(l4-2)*tick,"sell at bid")
  e4:Audit()
 end)
 return report
end
return Tests
ServerScriptService.MarketReign.MarketSe:
local ReplicatedStorage=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local TeleportService=game:GetService("TeleportService")
local root=ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("MarketReign")
local Config=require(root.MarketConfig)
local Progression=require(root.ProgressionConfig)
local World=require(script.Parent.WorldService)
local Funded=require(script.Parent.FundedAccounts)
local Leaderboards=require(script.Parent.LeaderboardService)
local Ranking=require(script.Parent.LeaderboardRanking)
local ReplyBuffer=require(script.Parent.ReplyBuffer)
local WorldSettings=require(script.Parent.WorldConfig)
Funded.Validate(Progression) -- Fail closed on invalid progression configuration.
local function remote(name)
 local old=root:FindFirstChild(name) if old then old:Destroy() end
 local r=Instance.new("RemoteEvent") r.Name=name r.Parent=root return r
end
local requestRemote=remote("OrderRequest") local updateRemote=remote("MarketUpdate")
local world=World.new(Config)
local leaderboard=Leaderboards.new({Studio=world.Studio})
world.CaptureProjection=function(engine)return Ranking.Capture(Funded.new(engine,Progression,Config))end
local oldLeaderboard=root:FindFirstChild("LeaderboardRequest") if oldLeaderboard then oldLeaderboard:Destroy() end
local leaderboardRemote=Instance.new("RemoteFunction") leaderboardRemote.Name="LeaderboardRequest" leaderboardRemote.Parent=root
local market,population,funded local epoch=-1
root:SetAttribute("SessionSeed",nil) root:SetAttribute("Ready",false)
local clients={} local queue={} local sequence=0 local actionLog={}
-- Acknowledgements are bounded per connection by count and age (see ReplyBuffer).
local replies=ReplyBuffer.new(WorldSettings.MaxQueuedReplies,WorldSettings.ReplyMaxAgeSeconds)
-- Joining idempotently creates one $5,000 account for a new player.
local function resolve(player,state)
 if not funded then return end
 funded:Join(state.Uid) funded:Evaluate(state.Uid)
 local p=funded:Profile(state.Uid)
 if p then p.PlayerName=player.Name;p.DisplayName=player.DisplayName end
 state.Owner=funded:Owner(state.Uid) state.Full=true state.PortfolioRevision=nil
end
local function add(player)
 if clients[player] then return end
 clients[player]={Uid=Funded.Key(player.UserId),Contract=Config.ContractOrder[1],Timeframe="1m",Full=true,Tokens=20,TokenTime=os.clock(),
  Seen={},SeenOrder={},Replies={},ReplyTimes={},Subscribed=false,PortfolioAt=0}
 resolve(player,clients[player])
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(add) for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do add(p) end
leaderboardRemote.OnServerInvoke=function(player,tab)
 local state=clients[player]
 if not state or (tab~="Global" and tab~="Server") then return nil end
 -- Read-only endpoint; rate limits are independent of order traffic. No scores/ids accepted.
 local now=os.clock()
 if now<(state.LeaderboardAt or 0) then return {Tab=tab,State="Throttled"} end
 state.LeaderboardAt=now+2
 if not funded or not world:CanRun() then return {Tab=tab,State="Loading",Rows={},Studio=world.Studio} end
 if tab=="Server" then return leaderboard:Server(funded,Players:GetPlayers(),player) end
 local own=Ranking.Row(funded,state.Uid,player)
 return leaderboard:Global(own)
end
-- Portfolio + projection accompany each price batch. Closed and open amounts are one snapshot.
local function attachPortfolio(state,packet)
 if not funded then return end
 packet.Events=funded:TakeEvents(state.Uid)
 local profile=funded:Profile(state.Uid)
 local revision=profile and profile.Revision or 0 local now=os.clock()
 packet.Portfolio=funded:View(state.Uid) state.PortfolioRevision=revision state.PortfolioAt=now
 -- Lifetime stats: sent on join/refresh and whenever a counted value changes (a close, a depletion,
 -- a restart). A failure here is isolated from trading and reported to the Stats page.
 local key=funded:StatsKey(state.Uid)
 if state.Full or key~=state.StatsKey then
  local ok,stats=pcall(funded.Stats,funded,state.Uid)
  if not ok then warn("[Get Funded!] Stats unavailable: "..tostring(stats)) end
  packet.Stats=ok and stats or {Error="Stats are temporarily unavailable. Your trades and saved results are not affected."}
  state.StatsKey=key
 end
end
local function emit(player,state)
 if funded and world:CanRun() and not funded:Owner(state.Uid) and os.clock()>=(state.JoinRetryAt or 0) then
  state.JoinRetryAt=os.clock()+5;resolve(player,state)
 end
 if funded then
  local owner=funded:Owner(state.Uid)
  if state.Owner~=owner then state.Owner=owner;state.Full=true end
 end
 local unavailable=not market or world.Mode=="Unavailable" or world.Mode=="Following" or world.Mode=="Loading"
 if unavailable or not state.Owner or not market.Accounts[state.Owner] then
  -- No trading account yet (first join) or the exchange is not ready: send status and portfolio only.
  local queued,dropped=replies:Take(state)
  local packet={StatusOnly=true,CanTrade=not unavailable and world:CanRun(),ConnectionStatus=world:Label(),Replies=queued,RepliesDropped=dropped,NoAccount=not unavailable or nil}
  if not unavailable then attachPortfolio(state,packet) state.Full=false end
  updateRemote:FireClient(player,packet)
  return
 end
 local packet=market:Snapshot(state.Owner,state.Contract,state.Timeframe,state.Full)
 packet.Seed=nil -- The server's future random stream is private.
 packet.CanTrade=world:CanRun() packet.ConnectionStatus=world:Label() packet.PersistenceMode=world.Mode
 -- Quotes/candles/P&L are frequent; unchanged order and trade histories are not resent.
 local orderParts={}
 for _,order in ipairs(packet.Orders)do
  table.insert(orderParts,table.concat({order.Id,order.Contract,order.Protection or "",order.Quantity,order.Price,order.Status},":"))
 end
 local orderSignature=table.concat(orderParts,"|")
 if not state.Full and state.SentRevision==packet.Revision and state.SentOwner==state.Owner then
  packet.History=nil packet.Fills=nil
 end
 -- OCO/trigger status can change before a closing execution changes the account revision.
 if not state.Full and state.SentOwner==state.Owner and state.SentOrders==orderSignature then
  packet.Orders=nil
 end
 for symbol,quote in pairs(packet.Quotes)do if symbol~=state.Contract then quote.Depth=nil end end
 state.SentRevision=packet.Revision state.SentOwner=state.Owner state.SentOrders=orderSignature
 packet.Regime=population.Regime.Name packet.News=market.Time<population.NewsUntil and population.News or nil
 packet.Speed=Config.SimulationSpeed packet.Replies,packet.RepliesDropped=replies:Take(state)
 packet.AccountKey=(funded:Profile(state.Uid) or {}).Active
 packet.AccountToken=state.Owner -- identifies the exact attempt; checked, never used to choose an owner
 attachPortfolio(state,packet)
 updateRemote:FireClient(player,packet) state.Full=false
end
local function reply(state,id,ok,message,result,extra)
 local r={RequestId=id,Ok=ok,Message=message,Result=result}
 for k,v in pairs(extra or {})do r[k]=v end
 replies:Push(state,r,os.clock())
end
local allowed={Place=true,Cancel=true,Close=true,Subscribe=true,AmendProtection=true,AmendOrder=true,
 Start=true,Restart=true,Flag=true,Stats=true}
local fields={"ExpectedAccount","Contract","Timeframe","Direction","Quantity","Type","Price","StopTicks","TargetTicks","StopDollars","TargetDollars","ExpectedQuantity","OrderId","Protection","ExpectedPrice",
 "Stage"}
requestRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,request)
 local state=clients[player]
 if not state or type(request)~="table" then return end
 local now=os.clock() state.Tokens=math.min(20,state.Tokens+(now-state.TokenTime)*6) state.TokenTime=now
 if state.Tokens<1 then return end state.Tokens-=1
 if type(request.Id)~="number" or request.Id%1~=0 or request.Id<1 or request.Id>1e9 or state.Seen[request.Id] then return end
 if not allowed[request.Action] then return end
 -- Whitelist scalar inputs. ExpectedAccount detects a stale view; it never selects an owner.
 -- Execution prices, timestamps and account ownership remain server-owned.
 local clean={Id=request.Id,Action=request.Action}
 for _,field in ipairs(fields) do
  local value=request[field]
  if value~=nil then
   if type(value)~="number" and type(value)~="string" then return end
   if type(value)=="number" and (value~=value or math.abs(value)>1e9) then return end
   if type(value)=="string" and #value>(field=="Followers" and 512 or field=="ExpectedAccount" and 64 or 32) then return end
   clean[field]=value
  end
 end
 if #queue>=256 then reply(state,clean.Id,false,"Exchange busy. Please retry.") return end
 state.Seen[clean.Id]=true table.insert(state.SeenOrder,clean.Id)
 if #state.SeenOrder>256 then state.Seen[table.remove(state.SeenOrder,1)]=nil end
 -- Read-only: resend the authoritative Stats packet with the next update (Stats page Retry).
 if clean.Action=="Stats"then state.StatsKey=nil return end
 if clean.Action=="Subscribe"then
  local valid=false for _,tf in ipairs(Config.Timeframes)do if tf[1]==clean.Timeframe then valid=true break end end
  if Config.Contracts[clean.Contract]and valid then
   state.Contract=clean.Contract state.Timeframe=clean.Timeframe state.Full=true state.Subscribed=true
   emit(player,state)
  end
  return
 end
 if not world:CanRun()then reply(state,clean.Id,false,world:Label())emit(player,state)return end
 sequence+=1 table.insert(queue,{Player=player,Request=clean,Sequence=sequence,Epoch=epoch,Owner=state.Owner})
end)
local function process(item)
 local state=clients[item.Player] if not state then return end
 if not world:CanRun() then reply(state,item.Request.Id,false,world:Label(),nil,{Kind=item.Request.Action}) return end
 if item.Epoch~=epoch then reply(state,item.Request.Id,false,"Exchange reconnected. Please submit your order again.")return end
 local req=item.Request local uid=state.Uid
 funded:Evaluate(uid)
 local owner=funded:Owner(uid)
 if state.Owner~=owner then
  state.Owner=owner;state.Full=true
  if req.Action=="Place" or req.Action=="Close" or req.Action=="Cancel" or req.Action=="AmendOrder" or req.Action=="AmendProtection" then
   reply(state,req.Id,false,"Your trading account changed after depletion. Review your current run and retry.") return
  end
 end
 -- Account lifecycle. Each is idempotent and validated against the saved profile.
 if req.Action=="Start" then
  local ok,message,created=funded:Start(uid)
  local profile=funded:Profile(uid);if profile then profile.PlayerName=item.Player.Name;profile.DisplayName=item.Player.DisplayName end
  state.Owner=funded:Owner(uid) state.Full=true
  reply(state,req.Id,ok,message,nil,{Kind="Start",Created=created}) return
 elseif req.Action=="Restart" then
  local ok,message=funded:Restart(uid,req.ExpectedAccount)
  if ok then state.Owner=funded:Owner(uid) state.Full=true end
  reply(state,req.Id,ok,message,nil,{Kind="Restart",Tier=req.Tier}) return
 elseif req.Action=="Flag" then
  local ok,message=funded:Flag(uid,req.Stage)
  reply(state,req.Id,ok,message,nil,{Kind="Flag",Stage=req.Stage}) return
 end
 -- Trading owner and current run token are resolved only on the server.
 local owner=state.Owner
 if item.Owner~=owner or req.ExpectedAccount~=owner then reply(state,req.Id,false,"Your trading account changed. Review your current run and retry.") return end
 if not owner or not market.Accounts[owner] then reply(state,req.Id,false,"Your trading account is loading.") return end
 local ok,result=Funded.Perform(market,owner,req)
 market:ProcessStops()
 funded:Evaluate(uid)
 local message=type(result)=="table" and Funded.Describe(result) or result or "Request rejected."
 reply(state,req.Id,ok,message,type(result)=="table" and result or nil,{Kind=req.Action})
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
 -- Accounts, resting orders and protection belong to the exchange, not the GUI connection.
 -- Leaving keeps risk and fills active; returning retrieves the same account.
 clients[player]=nil
end)
local routing={}
TeleportService.TeleportInitFailed:Connect(function(player)
 routing[player]=nil
 local state=clients[player]if state then state.NextRoute=os.clock()+10 end
end)
local function route(player,state)
 local owner=world.Owner
 if world.Studio or routing[player]or os.clock()<(state.NextRoute or 0)or not owner or
  owner.LeaseUntil<=os.time()or owner.JobId==""or owner.JobId==game.JobId then return end
 routing[player]=true state.NextRoute=os.clock()+15
 task.spawn(function()
  local ok,err=pcall(function()
   local options=Instance.new("TeleportOptions")options.ServerInstanceId=owner.JobId
   TeleportService:TeleportAsync(owner.PlaceId,{player},options)
  end)
  if not ok then routing[player]=nil warn("[Get Funded!] Exchange transfer will retry: "..tostring(err))end
 end)
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)routing[player]=nil end)
task.spawn(function()world:Open()end)
game:BindToClose(function()
 world:Close()
 leaderboard:Queue(world.DurableProjection)
 -- Exchange durability comes first. A missed publish is rebuilt from its save on the next owner.
 leaderboard.NextWrite=0;leaderboard:Flush()
end)
task.spawn(function()
 while not world.Closing do
  task.wait(5)
  leaderboard:Queue(world.DurableProjection)
  leaderboard:Flush()
 end
end)
local elapsed,broadcast,maintenance=0,0,0
local performance={Frames=0,Steps=0,TotalMs=0,MaxMs=0,Backlog=0}
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
 local started=os.clock()
 debug.profilebegin("FundedMarketHeartbeat")
 if epoch~=world.Epoch then
  epoch=world.Epoch market=world.Engine population=world.Population elapsed=0
  funded=market and Funded.new(market,Progression,Config,{Capacity=function(kind) return world:HasCapacity(kind) end}) or nil
  for player,state in pairs(clients)do state.Owner=nil resolve(player,state) end
 end
 local active=world:CanRun()
 root:SetAttribute("Ready",active)root:SetAttribute("PersistenceStatus",world:Label())
 if active then elapsed+=dt*Config.SimulationSpeed else elapsed=0 end
 broadcast+=dt maintenance+=dt local steps=0
 while active and elapsed>=Config.StepSeconds and steps<Config.MaxCatchupSteps do
  elapsed-=Config.StepSeconds steps+=1
  local pending=queue queue={}
  for _,item in ipairs(pending) do
   table.insert(actionLog,{Step=market.Step,Sequence=item.Sequence,Player=item.Player.UserId,Request=item.Request})
   if #actionLog>5000 then table.remove(actionLog,1) end
   process(item)
  end
  if world:CanRun() then population:Step() else break end
 end
 if not active and #queue>0 then
  for _,item in ipairs(queue)do local state=clients[item.Player]if state then reply(state,item.Request.Id,false,world:Label())end end
  queue={}
 end
 if maintenance>=1 then
  maintenance=0 task.spawn(function()world:Maintain()end)
  -- Resting orders and SL/TP can realize profit while a player is away; unlocks are still earned once.
  if active and funded then
   -- Progress from offline protective fills is evaluated on the same saved profile.
   
   for uid in pairs(market.Profiles)do funded:Evaluate(uid) end
  end
  -- Idle connections release expired acknowledgements even if they never send or subscribe again.
  local clock=os.clock() for _,state in pairs(clients)do replies:Prune(state,clock) end
  if world.Mode=="Following"then for player,state in pairs(clients)do route(player,state)end end
 end
 -- Do not skip simulation steps under load; catch up over subsequent frames.
 if broadcast>=Config.BroadcastSeconds then
  broadcast=broadcast%Config.BroadcastSeconds
  for player,state in pairs(clients) do if state.Subscribed then emit(player,state) end end
 end
 local ms=(os.clock()-started)*1000
 performance.Frames+=1 performance.Steps+=steps performance.TotalMs+=ms
 performance.MaxMs=math.max(performance.MaxMs,ms) performance.Backlog=elapsed
 debug.profileend()
end)
-- Read-only diagnostic access in Studio; never replicated to game clients.
if RunService:IsStudio() then
 local diagnostic=Instance.new("BindableFunction") diagnostic.Name="StudioDiagnostics" diagnostic.Parent=script.Parent
 diagnostic.OnInvoke=function(command,a,b)
  if command=="Tests" then return require(script.Parent.MarketTests).Run() end
  if command=="ContinuityTests"then return require(script.Parent.WorldTests).Run()end
  if command=="SingleAccountTests"then return require(script.Parent.SingleAccountTests).Run()end
  if command=="SecurityTests"then return require(script.Parent.SecurityTests).Run()end
  if command=="LeaderboardStatus"then return {Cached=leaderboard.Cache,ReadError=leaderboard.ReadError,WriteError=leaderboard.WriteError,Pending=leaderboard.Pending,Scope=Leaderboards.Scope(world.Studio)}end
  if command=="Performance"then local result=table.clone(performance);result.MeanMs=result.TotalMs/math.max(1,result.Frames);return result end
  if command=="Actions" then return actionLog end
  if not market then return {Mode=world.Mode,Status=world:Label(),Error=world.LastError}end
  if command=="Profiles"then
   local views={} for uid in pairs(market.Profiles)do views[uid]={Saved=market.Profiles[uid],View=funded:View(uid)}end return views
  end
  if command=="Stats"then
   local views={} for uid in pairs(market.Profiles)do views[uid]=funded:Stats(uid)end return views
  end
  local books={}
  for _,key in ipairs(Config.ContractOrder) do
   local book=market.Books[key]
   books[key]={Last=book.Last and book.Last*book.Spec.Tick,Volume=book.Volume,Up=book.Up,Down=book.Down,Bids=#book.Bids,Asks=#book.Asks,Candles=#book.Candles["1m"]}
  end
  local accounts={}
  for _,id in ipairs(market.AccountOrder) do local account=market.Accounts[id] if account.Player then accounts[id]=market:Snapshot(id,Config.ContractOrder[1],"1m",false) end end
  return {Seed=market.Seed,Mode=world.Mode,Status=world:Label(),Step=market.Step,Time=market.Time,Audit=market:Audit(),Books=books,Accounts=accounts,Participants=#population.Agents,Regime=population.Regime.Name}
 end
end
ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.ChartTools:
-- Chart drawings: stored in time (seconds) and price, never in pixels, so they stay attached to
-- the market when the chart pans, zooms, rescales or resizes. Presentation only.
local Tools={}
Tools.Colors={"Blue","Green","Red","Muted"} -- UI Kit palette keys; resolved by the view
Tools.Opacities={0.08,0.15,0.25,0.4}
Tools.Defaults={Rect={Border="Blue",Fill="Blue",Opacity=0.15},Trend={Border="Blue"},Line={Border="Blue"}}
Tools.HitTolerance={Mouse=6,Touch=14}
Tools.HandleRadius={Mouse=8,Touch=20}
local nextId=0
function Tools.NewId() nextId+=1 return "d"..nextId.."-"..math.floor(os.clock()*1000)%100000 end
local function copy(d) local r={} for k,v in pairs(d)do r[k]=v end return r end
Tools.Copy=copy
function Tools.CopyList(list) local r={} for i,d in ipairs(list)do r[i]=copy(d)end return r end
-- Gives legacy drawings an id and style so they can be selected, edited and undone.
function Tools.Normalize(d)
 d.Id=d.Id or Tools.NewId()
 local defaults=Tools.Defaults[d.Kind] or {}
 for k,v in pairs(defaults)do if d[k]==nil then d[k]=v end end
 return d
end
function Tools.New(kind,a,b,contract,timeframe)
 local d={Kind=kind,Contract=contract,Timeframe=timeframe,T1=a.Time,P1=a.Price}
 if kind~="Line" then d.T2=b.Time d.P2=b.Price end
 return Tools.Normalize(d)
end
-- Rectangle corners: 1=(T1,P1) 2=(T2,P1) 3=(T2,P2) 4=(T1,P2).
local cornerFields={{"T1","P1"},{"T2","P1"},{"T2","P2"},{"T1","P2"}}
Tools.CornerFields=cornerFields
function Tools.Points(d)
 if d.Kind=="Rect" then
  local pts={} for i,f in ipairs(cornerFields)do pts[i]={Time=d[f[1]],Price=d[f[2]],Part="Corner"..i} end return pts
 elseif d.Kind=="Trend" then return {{Time=d.T1,Price=d.P1,Part="P1"},{Time=d.T2,Price=d.P2,Part="P2"}}
 end
 return {}
end
-- A rectangle's extension handle: the midpoint of its right edge, in the caller's pixel space.
function Tools.ExtendPoint(d,toX,toY)
 return math.max(toX(d.T1),toX(d.T2)),(toY(d.P1)+toY(d.P2))/2
end
-- Strong magnet: nearest candle open/high/low/close anywhere in screen space.
-- toX/toY map time/price to pixels in the same space as x,y.
function Tools.Snap(candles,toX,toY,x,y)
 local best,bestD=nil,math.huge
 for _,c in ipairs(candles)do
  local cx=toX(c.Time)
  if (cx-x)^2<=bestD then
   for _,field in ipairs({"Open","High","Low","Close"})do
    local cy=toY(c[field]) local d=(cx-x)^2+(cy-y)^2
    if d<=bestD then best={Time=c.Time,Price=c[field],Field=field,X=cx,Y=cy} bestD=d end
   end
  end
 end
 return best
end
local function segmentDistance(px,py,x1,y1,x2,y2)
 local dx,dy=x2-x1,y2-y1 local len=dx*dx+dy*dy
 local t=len>0 and math.clamp(((px-x1)*dx+(py-y1)*dy)/len,0,1) or 0
 local qx,qy=x1+t*dx,y1+t*dy return math.sqrt((px-qx)^2+(py-qy)^2)
end
Tools.SegmentDistance=segmentDistance
-- Returns {Drawing,Part,Interior} for the topmost drawing under the pointer.
-- The selected rectangle has an "Extend" dot at the midpoint of its right edge (checked first, slightly tighter
-- than corner handles so a small rectangle's corners stay reachable). Other handles belong to the
-- selected drawing only. A rectangle's body is "Slide" (horizontal move).
-- Interiors of unselected rectangles are flagged Interior: the view decides whether a drag there
-- moves the rectangle (mouse) or pans the chart (touch, where rectangles cover a small plot).
function Tools.HitTest(drawings,toX,toY,x,y,tolerance,handleRadius,selectedId,width)
 local extendRadius=math.max(4,handleRadius-2)
 for i=#drawings,1,-1 do
  local d=drawings[i]
  if d.Kind=="Rect" and d.Id==selectedId then
   local ex,ey=Tools.ExtendPoint(d,toX,toY)
   if math.abs(ex-x)<=extendRadius and math.abs(ey-y)<=extendRadius then return {Drawing=d,Part="Extend"} end
  end
 end
 for i=#drawings,1,-1 do
  local d=drawings[i]
  if d.Id==selectedId then
   for _,pt in ipairs(Tools.Points(d))do
    local hx,hy=toX(pt.Time),toY(pt.Price)
    if math.abs(hx-x)<=handleRadius and math.abs(hy-y)<=handleRadius then return {Drawing=d,Part=pt.Part} end
   end
  end
 end

function Tools.Edit(target,original,part,point,delta)

  -- edge (it keeps at least delta.MinWidth seconds, one candle, of width).
  local right=(original.T2 or original.T1)>=original.T1 and "T2" or "T1" local left=right=="T2" and "T1" or "T2"
  target[right]=math.max(point.Time,original[left]+(delta and delta.MinWidth or 0))

   else if r<t0 then return nil elseif r<t1 then t1=r end end

end

end

-- A separate pool lets hover, drawing previews and crosshair labels update without touching candles.
-- Full paints also refresh it, so incoming quotes and changed transforms are always reflected.

end

function View:SetCursor(icon)
 if self.Cursor~=icon then self.Cursor=icon;pcall(function()UIS.MouseIcon=icon end)end
end
function View:UpdateCursor()
 if self.LastTouch or not UIS.MouseEnabled then return end
 local d=self.Drag local icon=""
 if d then
  icon=d.Kind=="Pan"and(d.Moved and CURSOR.Grab or CURSOR.Hand)or(d.Kind=="Scale"or d.Kind=="Protection"or d.Kind=="Order")and CURSOR.NS
   or d.Kind=="Edit"and((d.Part=="Slide"or d.Part=="Extend")and CURSOR.EW or d.Part=="Move"and CURSOR.Move or(d.Part=="Corner1"or d.Part=="Corner3")and CURSOR.NWSE or CURSOR.NESW)
   or CURSOR.Cross
  if d.Kind=="Edit"and d.Target.Kind=="Rect"and(d.Part=="Corner1"or d.Part=="Corner3")then
   -- Corner orientation depends on which way the rectangle is stored.
   local up=(d.Target.P1>d.Target.P2)==(d.Target.T1<d.Target.T2) icon=up and CURSOR.NWSE or CURSOR.NESW
  elseif d.Kind=="Edit"and d.Target.Kind=="Rect"and(d.Part=="Corner2"or d.Part=="Corner4")then
   local up=(d.Target.P1>d.Target.P2)==(d.Target.T1<d.Target.T2) icon=up and CURSOR.NESW or CURSOR.NWSE
  elseif d.Kind=="Edit"and d.Part~="Move"and d.Part~="Slide"and d.Part~="Extend"then icon=CURSOR.Move end
 elseif self.Hover and self.Geometry then
  local x,y=self:Local(self.Hover) local g=self.Geometry
  if y>=0 and y<=g.Height and x>=0 then
   if x>g.Width then icon=CURSOR.NS
   elseif DRAW[self.S.Tool]then icon=CURSOR.Cross
   else
    local hit=self:Hit(x,y,false)
    local prot=false
    for _,ph in ipairs(g.ProtectionHits)do if math.abs(y-ph.Y)<=6 then prot=true end end
    local grab=hit and(not hit.Interior or hit.Part=="Slide")
    local order,part=self:OrderHit(x,y,false)
    icon=order and(part=="Cancel"and CURSOR.Point or CURSOR.NS)or prot and CURSOR.NS or grab and((hit.Part=="Slide"or hit.Part=="Extend")and CURSOR.EW or hit.Part=="Move"and CURSOR.Move or CURSOR.Point)
     or self.S.Tool=="Crosshair"and CURSOR.Cross or CURSOR.Hand
   end
  end
 end
 self:SetCursor(icon)
end

-- Input
function View:Blocked()
 local s=self.S return not self.Geometry or s.Overlay or s.Sheet or self.Ctx.Options.Preview
end
function View:WorkingOrder(id)
 for _,o in ipairs(self.Ctx.Session.Orders or {})do if o.Id==id and not o.Protection then return o end end
end
function View:OrderHit(x,y,touch)
 -- Buttons win over lines, including when two orders share a price.
 for _,m in ipairs(self.OrderMarkers or {})do
  if x>=m.X and x<=m.X+m.W and y>=m.Top and y<=m.Top+m.H then return m,x>=m.CancelX and "Cancel"or"Drag" end
 end
 for _,m in ipairs(self.OrderMarkers or {})do
  if m.Type=="Limit" and m.Y and math.abs(y-m.Y)<=(touch and 12 or 5)then return m,"Drag" end
 end
end
function View:Began(ev)
 local kind=ev.UserInputType
 -- Right-click cancels an in-progress drawing or edit (Esc is reserved for the Roblox menu in-game).
 -- Otherwise it opens the order menu at the clicked price.
 if kind==MB2 then
  if self.Drag or self.Placement or DRAW[self.S.Tool] then self:Cancel();self.Ctx.refresh() else self:OpenOrderMenu(Vector2.new(ev.Position.X,ev.Position.Y))end
  return
 end
 if kind~=MB1 and kind~=MB3 and kind~=TOUCH then return end
 if self:Blocked()then return end
 local g=self.Geometry local s=self.S local session=self.Ctx.Session
 local pos=Vector2.new(ev.Position.X,ev.Position.Y)
 self.LastTouch=kind==TOUCH
 if kind==TOUCH then
  self.Touches[ev]=pos
  if count(self.Touches)>=2 then
   local d=self.Drag
   if not d or d.Kind=="Pan"or d.Kind=="Inspect"then self:StartPinch()end
   return
  end
 end
 if self.Drag then return end
 local x,y=self:Local(pos)
 if y<0 or y>g.Height or x<0 then return end
 local base={Input=ev,Type=kind,Start=pos,View=g.View,State=g.State,Width=g.Width,Height=g.Height,Moved=false}
 local function start(kindName,extra) local d=table.clone(base) d.Kind=kindName for k,v in pairs(extra or {})do d[k]=v end self.Drag=d self.Dirty=true return d end
 -- X consumes the gesture and only cancels its order; it can never become a chart drag.
 if kind~=MB3 then
  local marker,part=self:OrderHit(x,y,kind==TOUCH)
  if marker then
   if self.OrderPending or self.Pending then return end
   if part=="Cancel"then
    start("CancelOrder",{Id=marker.Id,Base=session.AccountKey});return
   elseif marker.Type=="Limit"then
    start("Order",{Id=marker.Id,Key=g.Key,Contract=s.Contract,Base=session.AccountKey,Original=marker.ConfirmedPrice,Price=marker.ConfirmedPrice,Quantity=marker.Quantity});return
   end
  end
 end
 -- Stop and target labels keep priority over drawing tools.
 local held=session.Positions[s.Contract]
 if kind~=MB3 and held and not held.Triggered and not self.Pending then
  local chosen,distance=nil,math.huge
  for _,hit in ipairs(g.ProtectionHits)do
   local label=x<=hit.Width or x>=g.Width
   local tolerance=kind==TOUCH and(label and 22 or 14)or(label and 10 or 6)
   local d=math.abs(y-hit.Y)
   if d<=tolerance and d<distance then chosen=hit.Field;distance=d end
  end
  if chosen then
   start("Protection",{Field=chosen,Key=g.Key,Contract=s.Contract,Base=session.AccountKey,Id=held.Id,Original=held[chosen],Price=held[chosen]})
   self.Ctx.Root:SetAttribute("DraggingProtection",chosen);return
  end
 end
 if x>g.Width then
  -- Price axis: drag to scale, double-click/double-tap to restore auto-fit.
  local now=os.clock() local lastTap=self.LastAxisTap
  if lastTap and now-lastTap.Time<0.4 and(lastTap.Pos-pos).Magnitude<16 then self.LastAxisTap=nil;self:AutoFit();return end
  self.LastAxisTap={Time=now,Pos=pos}
  start("Scale");return
 end
 if self.Pending or self.OrderPending then return end
 if kind==MB3 then start("Pan");return end
 local tool=s.Tool
 if DRAW[tool]then
  local pt=self:PointAt(x,y,true,kind==TOUCH)
  if tool=="Line"then start("PlaceLine",{Point=pt});return end
  if self.Placement and self.Placement.Waiting then
   self.Placement.B=pt;self:CommitPlacement();self.Ctx.onIdle(true);return
  end
  self.Placement={Kind=tool,A=pt,B=pt};start("Place");return
 end
 if tool=="Crosshair"and kind==TOUCH then self.Hover=pos;start("Inspect");return end
 local hit=self:Hit(x,y,kind==TOUCH)
 -- With a mouse, pressing anywhere on a rectangle grabs it (selects it and slides it horizontally), so
 -- a drag on a rectangle never pans the chart. On touch an unselected interior still pans; tap to select.
 if hit and(not hit.Interior or(kind~=TOUCH and hit.Part=="Slide"))then
  local d=hit.Drawing
  start("Edit",{Part=hit.Part,Target=d,Original=Tools.Copy(d),Before=Tools.CopyList(s.Drawings),StartPoint=self:PointAt(x,y,false),SelectChanged=self.Selected~=d.Id})
  if hit.Part=="Move" or hit.Part=="Slide" then
   local anchors=Tools.Points(d)
   if d.Kind=="Line" then anchors={{Time=self.Drag.StartPoint.Time,Price=d.P1}} end
   local nearest=math.huge
   for _,pt in ipairs(anchors)do
    local dist=(g.X(pt.Time)-x)^2+(g.Y(pt.Price)-y)^2
    if dist<nearest then nearest=dist;self.Drag.Anchor=pt end
   end
  end
  self.Selected=d.Id;return
 end
 start("Pan",{Click=hit and hit.Drawing.Id or false})
end
function View:StartPinch()
 local g=self.Geometry if not g then return end
 local a,b local list={} for input,pos in pairs(self.Touches)do table.insert(list,{input,pos})end
 a,b=list[1],list[2]
 if self.Drag and self.Drag.Kind=="Pan"then self.Drag=nil end
 local mid=(a[2]+b[2])/2
 local x=(mid.X-g.Plot.AbsolutePosition.X-g.Left)/g.Width
 self.Drag={Kind="Pinch",A=a[1],B=b[1],StartDistance=math.max(20,(a[2]-b[2]).Magnitude),StartFraction=x,StartMid=mid,View=g.View,State=g.State,
  Width=g.Width,Height=g.Height,Moved=true,Type=TOUCH}
 self.Hover=nil self.Dirty=true
end
function View:UpdatePinch()
 local d=self.Drag local pa,pb=self.Touches[d.A],self.Touches[d.B]
 if not pa or not pb then return end
 local g=self.Geometry
 local mid=(pa+pb)/2 local dist=math.max(20,(pa-pb).Magnitude)
 local fraction=(mid.X-g.Plot.AbsolutePosition.X-g.Left)/d.Width
 Viewport.Pinch(d.State,d.View,d.StartFraction,fraction,d.StartDistance/dist,mid.Y-d.StartMid.Y,d.Height)
 self.Dirty=true
end
function View:Changed(ev)
 local kind=ev.UserInputType
 if kind==TOUCH and self.Touches[ev]then self.Touches[ev]=Vector2.new(ev.Position.X,ev.Position.Y)end
 if kind==MOVE then self.LastTouch=false end
 local d=self.Drag
 if not d then return end
 if d.Kind=="Pinch"then if kind==TOUCH then self:UpdatePinch()end return end
 if d.Type==TOUCH then if ev~=d.Input then return end elseif kind~=MOVE then return end
 local pos=Vector2.new(ev.Position.X,ev.Position.Y)
 local delta=pos-d.Start
 if not d.Moved and delta.Magnitude<(d.Type==TOUCH and 8 or 4)then return end
 d.Moved=true
 self.Hover=pos
 if d.Kind=="Pan"then Viewport.Pan(d.State,d.View,delta.X,delta.Y,d.Width,d.Height)
 elseif d.Kind=="Scale"then Viewport.ScalePrice(d.State,d.View,delta.Y,d.Height)
 elseif d.Kind=="Protection"or d.Kind=="Order"then
  local Market=self.Ctx.Market local tick=Market.Contracts[d.Contract].Tick
  d.Price=math.max(tick,Market.Snap(d.Original-delta.Y/d.Height*(d.View.High-d.View.Low),d.Contract))
 elseif self.Geometry then
  local x,y=self:Local(pos)
  if d.Kind=="Edit"then
   local pt=self:DrawingPointAt(x,y,d.Type==TOUCH)
   local origin=d.Anchor or d.StartPoint
   local Market=self.Ctx.Market
   Tools.Edit(d.Target,d.Original,d.Part,pt,{Time=pt.Time-origin.Time,Price=pt.Snap and pt.Price-origin.Price or Market.Snap(pt.Price-origin.Price,self.S.Contract),
    MinWidth=self.Geometry.View.Interval})
  elseif d.Kind=="Place"then self.Placement.B=self:PointAt(x,y,true,d.Type==TOUCH)
  elseif d.Kind=="PlaceLine"then d.Point=self:PointAt(x,y,true,d.Type==TOUCH)
  end
 end
 self.Dirty=true
end
function View:Ended(ev)
 local kind=ev.UserInputType
 if kind==TOUCH then self.Touches[ev]=nil end
 local d=self.Drag if not d then return end
 if d.Kind=="Pinch"then
  if kind~=TOUCH then return end
  local remaining,pos=next(self.Touches)
  if remaining and self.Geometry then
   -- Lifting one finger continues as a one-finger pan from where it is.
   local g=self.Geometry
   self.Drag={Kind="Pan",Input=remaining,Type=TOUCH,Start=pos,View=g.View,State=g.State,Width=g.Width,Height=g.Height,Moved=true}
  else self:Finish(true)end
  return
 end
 if d.Type==TOUCH then if ev~=d.Input then return end elseif kind~=d.Type then return end
 self:Finish(ev.UserInputState~=Enum.UserInputState.Cancel)
end
function View:Finish(commit)
 local d=self.Drag if not d then return end
 self.Drag=nil
 local s=self.S local chrome=false
 self.Ctx.Root:SetAttribute("DraggingProtection",nil)
 if d.Kind=="Pan"then
  if not d.Moved and commit then
   local chosen=d.Click or nil
   if chosen~=self.Selected then self.Selected=chosen;chrome=true end
  end
  if d.Type==TOUCH then self.Hover=nil end
 elseif d.Kind=="Edit"then
  if not commit then for k in pairs(d.Target)do d.Target[k]=nil end for k,v in pairs(d.Original)do d.Target[k]=v end
  elseif d.Moved then self.History:Push(d.Before);chrome=true end
  if d.SelectChanged then chrome=true end
  if d.Type==TOUCH then self.Hover=nil end
 elseif d.Kind=="Place"then
  if not commit or not self.Placement then self.Placement=nil
  elseif d.Moved then self:CommitPlacement();chrome=true
  else self.Placement.Waiting=true end
 elseif d.Kind=="PlaceLine"then
  if commit then
   local before=Tools.CopyList(s.Drawings)
   local line=Tools.New("Line",d.Point,nil,s.Contract,s.Timeframe)
   table.insert(s.Drawings,line);self.History:Push(before);self.Selected=line.Id;s.Tool="Pan";chrome=true
  end
 elseif d.Kind=="CancelOrder"then
  if commit and not d.Moved and d.Base==self.Ctx.Session.AccountKey then
   local ok,message=self.Ctx.Session:Cancel(d.Id)
   if not ok then self.Ctx.toast(message,"error")end
  end
 elseif d.Kind=="Order"then
  if commit and d.Moved and d.Price~=d.Original then
   local ok,message,_,requestId=self.Ctx.Session:AmendOrder(d.Contract,d.Id,d.Price,d.Original,d.Quantity)
   if ok then
    d.RequestId=requestId;self.OrderPending=d
    task.delay(10,function()
     if self.OrderPending==d then self.OrderPending=nil;self.Dirty=true;self.Ctx.toast("Limit update not confirmed. Restored the last server price.","error")end
    end)
   else self.Ctx.toast(message,"error")end
  end
 elseif d.Kind=="Protection"then
  if commit and d.Moved and d.Price~=d.Original then
   local ok,message,_,requestId=self.Ctx.Session:AmendProtection(d.Contract,d.Id,d.Field,d.Price,d.Original)
   if ok then
    d.RequestId=requestId;self.Pending=d
    task.delay(10,function()
     if self.Pending==d then self.Pending=nil;self.Dirty=true;self.Ctx.toast("Update not yet confirmed. Showing the last server price.")end
    end)
   else self.Ctx.toast(message)end
  end
 elseif d.Kind=="Inspect"then self.Hover=nil
 end
 self.Dirty=true
 self.Ctx.onIdle(chrome)
end
function View:CommitPlacement()
 local p=self.Placement self.Placement=nil
 local s=self.S local g=self.Geometry
 if not p or not p.B or not g then return end
 -- Ignore a zero-size shape (a click without a second point).
 local w=math.abs(g.X(p.A.Time)-g.X(p.B.Time)) local h=math.abs(g.Y(p.A.Price)-g.Y(p.B.Price))
 if(p.Kind=="Rect"and(w<3 or h<3))or(p.Kind=="Trend"and w+h<4)then return end
 local before=Tools.CopyList(s.Drawings)
 local d=Tools.New(p.Kind,p.A,p.B,s.Contract,s.Timeframe)
 table.insert(s.Drawings,d);self.History:Push(before);self.Selected=d.Id;s.Tool="Pan"
end
function View:Wheel(ev)
 local g=self.Geometry
 if not g or self.Drag or self.Pending or self.OrderPending or self:Blocked()then return end
 local x=(ev.Position.X-g.Plot.AbsolutePosition.X-g.Left)/g.Width
 Viewport.Zoom(g.State,g.View,ev.Position.Z>0 and 0.85 or 1/0.85,x);self.Dirty=true
end
-- Returns true when the key was used by the chart.
function View:KeyBegan(ev)
 local key=ev.KeyCode
 if key==Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt or key==Enum.KeyCode.RightAlt then self:ModifierChanged();return false end
 if key==Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl or key==Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then self.Ctrl=true;self:ModifierChanged();return false end
 if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox()then return false end
 local ctrl=UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightControl)
 local shift=UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift)or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift)
 if key==Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
  if self.Menu then self:CloseOrderMenu();return true end
  if self.Drag or self.Placement then self:Cancel();self.Ctx.refresh();return true end
  if DRAW[self.S.Tool]then self.S.Tool="Pan";self.Ctx.refresh();return true end
  if self.Selected then self.Selected=nil;self.Ctx.refresh();return true end
  return false
 elseif(key==Enum.KeyCode.Delete or key==Enum.KeyCode.Backspace)and self:SelectedDrawing()and not self.Drag then
  self:DeleteSelected();return true
 elseif ctrl and key==Enum.KeyCode.Z and not self.Drag then if shift then self:Redo()else self:Undo()end return true
 elseif ctrl and key==Enum.KeyCode.Y and not self.Drag then self:Redo();return true
 end

function View:KeyEnded(ev)

 end

 self:UpdateOrderMenu()
 local session=self.Ctx.Session local d=self.Drag

 if d and d.Kind=="Protection"then
  local held=session.Positions[d.Contract]
  if session.AccountKey~=d.Base or not held or held.Id~=d.Id or held.Triggered or held[d.Field]~=d.Original then
   self:Finish(false);message="Position or protection changed. Drag cancelled."
  end
 end
 if d and d.Kind=="Order"then
  local o=self:WorkingOrder(d.Id)
  if session.AccountKey~=d.Base or not o or o.Price~=d.Original or o.Quantity~=d.Quantity then
   self:Finish(false);message="Limit order changed or filled. Drag cancelled."

 end
 if self.OrderPending then
  local p=self.OrderPending
  if p.Base~=session.AccountKey or not self:WorkingOrder(p.Id)then self.OrderPending=nil end
 end
 local pending=self.Pending
 if pending then
  local held=session.Positions[pending.Contract]

 end

 m.Backdrop=backdrop

  end,C.Raised,C.Text,15,96),o.Gloss)

  m.Buttons[i]={Button=b,Option=o}

-- Keeps the menu honest while prices move: the choices are rebuilt if the market crosses the clicked
-- price (and it closes if the market sits exactly on it). Changing instrument or opening a popup closes it.
function View:UpdateOrderMenu()

 self.History:Record(self.S.Drawings) d[field]=value self.Ctx.refresh()
end
function View:CycleFill()

 local list=Tools.Colors local nextValue=list[1]
 for i,v in ipairs(list)do if v==d.Fill then nextValue=list[i%#list+1]end end
 self.History:Record(self.S.Drawings) d.Fill=nextValue self.Ctx.refresh()
end

 local list=Tools.Opacities local nextValue=list[1]
 for i,v in ipairs(list)do if math.abs(v-(d.Opacity or 0.15))<0.001 then nextValue=list[i%#list+1]end end
 self.History:Record(self.S.Drawings) d.Opacity=nextValue self.Ctx.refresh()

function View:AutoFit() local state=self:ActiveState() if state then Viewport.AutoFit(state);self.Dirty=true end end

-- Lossless execution state, including FIFO identity and the participants' next random draw.
local Engine=require(script.Parent.MarketEngine)
local Participants=require(script.Parent.Participants)
local TradeStats=require(script.Parent.TradeStats)
local Http=game:GetService("HttpService")
local Encoding=game:GetService("EncodingService")
-- Version 3 introduces E-minis, retained close-only micro books and equity-only failure.
-- Version 4 adds armed stop entry orders, which wait off the order book. An older build would
-- rest them as limits, so it must fail closed on V4. V1-V3 are read unchanged.
-- Version 5 executes player orders off the order book against a saved house counterparty account. An older
-- build would rest player limits in the book again and liquidate the house as a bot, so it fails closed on V5.
-- V1-V4 restore unchanged; player limits they saved in the book come back off-book (see Restore).
-- V6 permanently separates tier access, account instances and Shop receipts. Older writers must
-- refuse it, otherwise they could reset permanent entitlements or spend the wallet twice.
-- V7 renames ES/NQ to BX/BT, keeps RTY/YM only as retired close-only books and adds BG. Older builds
-- cannot map those markets, so they must refuse V7. V1-V6 saves migrate on restore (see plan and rename).
-- V8 adds the single-account profile. Older writers must fail closed.
local Checkpoint={Version=8,Readable={[1]=true,[2]=true,[3]=true,[4]=true,[5]=true,[6]=true,[7]=true,[8]=true}}
local function digest(raw)
 local bytes=Encoding:ComputeStringHash(raw,Enum.HashAlgorithm.Sha256)
 return (bytes:gsub(".",function(c)return string.format("%02x",string.byte(c))end))
end
local function clone(value)
 if type(value)~="table"then return value end
 local result={} for key,v in pairs(value)do result[key]=clone(v)end return result
end
-- Maps each saved market to its current symbol (config.Renamed) and checks its economics: every saved market
-- must still exist as a current or retired (close-only) contract with the same tick and multiplier. The
-- restored order is every current market, then the retired markets the save held. A current market the
-- save lacks opens as a new book after restore (`added`).
local function plan(saved,current)
 assert(saved.StepSeconds==current.StepSeconds,"Saved market step size differs from configuration")
 local renamed,held,map=current.Renamed or {},{},{}
 for _,key in ipairs(saved.ContractOrder)do
  local name=renamed[key] or key
  local a,b=saved.Contracts[key],current.Contracts[name] or current.LegacyContracts[name]
  assert(a and b and not held[name] and a.Tick==b.Tick and a.Multiplier==b.Multiplier,"Saved contract specification changed: "..key)
  held[name]=true map[key]=name
 end
 local order,added={},{}
 for _,key in ipairs(current.ContractOrder)do table.insert(order,key) if not held[key] then added[key]=true end end
 for _,key in ipairs(current.LegacyOrder)do if held[key] and not current.Contracts[key] then table.insert(order,key) end end
 assert(#saved.Timeframes==#current.Timeframes,"Saved timeframes differ")
 for i,tf in ipairs(current.Timeframes)do assert(saved.Timeframes[i][1]==tf[1]and saved.Timeframes[i][2]==tf[2],"Saved timeframe changed")end
 return map,order,added
end
-- Moves renamed markets in saved state: table keys and the fields that name a market (Contract, Key) take the
-- current symbol. Saved ids stay opaque and unchanged (for example participant accounts "bot:ES:Maker:1").
local function rename(value,map,field)
 if type(value)=="string"then return (field=="Contract"or field=="Key")and map[value]or value end
 if type(value)~="table"then return value end
 local result={}
 for key,v in pairs(value)do result[type(key)=="string"and map[key]or key]=rename(v,map,key)end
 return result
end
function Checkpoint.Capture(engine,population)
 local e={Accounts={},Books={},Orders={},Profiles=clone(engine.Profiles or {})}
 for _,key in ipairs({"Seed","Time","Step","NextOrder","NextTrade","TotalVolume","TradeHash","PendingStops"})do e[key]=clone(engine[key])end
 for _,id in ipairs(engine.AccountOrder)do
  local a=clone(engine.Accounts[id]);a.OpenOrders=nil
  -- Bot histories are display-only; balances, cash ledger and inventory are retained exactly.
  if not a.Player then a.History={} a.Fills={}end
  table.insert(e.Accounts,a)
 end
 for _,key in ipairs(engine.Config.ContractOrder)do
  local book={}
  for field,value in pairs(engine.Books[key])do if field~="Bids"and field~="Asks"and field~="Spec"then book[field]=clone(value)end end
  e.Books[key]=book
 end
 local ids={}for id in pairs(engine.Orders)do table.insert(ids,id)end table.sort(ids)
 for _,id in ipairs(ids)do table.insert(e.Orders,clone(engine.Orders[id]))end
 local p={RandomState=population.Random.State}
 for key,value in pairs(population)do if key~="Engine"and key~="Config"and key~="Random"then p[key]=clone(value)end end
 return {Version=Checkpoint.Version,Config=clone(engine.Config),Engine=e,Population=p}
end
function Checkpoint.Restore(snapshot,currentConfig)
 assert(type(snapshot)=="table"and Checkpoint.Readable[snapshot.Version],"Unsupported saved market format")
 local map,order,added=plan(snapshot.Config,currentConfig)
 for old,name in pairs(map)do if old~=name then snapshot=rename(snapshot,map) break end end
 -- Preserve the saved simulation configuration for exact continuation; presentation cadence may change.
 local config=clone(snapshot.Config)
 config.DailyLossLimit=nil
 for _,key in ipairs({"LegacyOrder","LegacyContracts","LegacyToCurrent","Renamed"})do config[key]=clone(currentConfig[key])end
 config.ContractOrder=order
 local retiring={}
 for _,key in ipairs(order)do
  local current=currentConfig.Contracts[key] or currentConfig.LegacyContracts[key]
  local spec=config.Contracts[key]
  if added[key] then
   spec=clone(current) config.Contracts[key]=spec
   -- A new book starts near the saved market it succeeds, without relabelling historical executions or volume.
   for old,successor in pairs(currentConfig.LegacyToCurrent)do
    local b=successor==key and snapshot.Engine.Books[old]
    if b then spec.Last=(b.Last or b.Reference)*config.Contracts[old].Tick end
   end
  else
   -- Saved economics stay exact (checked in plan); names and the close-only rule follow this build.
   if current.CloseOnly and not spec.CloseOnly then retiring[key]=true end
   spec.Name=current.Name spec.Short=current.Short spec.CloseOnly=current.CloseOnly
  end
 end
 -- MaxCandles only bounds chart history (matching never reads candles), so a restored world adopts the current limit.
 for _,key in ipairs({"BroadcastSeconds","SimulationSpeed","MaxCatchupSteps","MaxCandles","MaxPlayerQuantity","MaxPlayerInventory","MaxPlayerOrders"})do config[key]=currentConfig[key]end
 -- Simulated margin is buying-power policy; contract economics and all saved ledgers stay intact.
 for key,spec in pairs(config.Contracts) do
  local current=currentConfig.Contracts[key] or currentConfig.LegacyContracts[key]
  if current then spec.Margin=current.Margin end
 end
 local data=snapshot.Engine local engine=Engine.new(config,data.Seed)
 for _,key in ipairs({"Time","Step","NextOrder","NextTrade","TotalVolume","TradeHash","PendingStops"})do engine[key]=clone(data[key])end
 for _,a in ipairs(data.Accounts)do
  local account=clone(a);account.OpenOrders={}
  account.LossLimit=account.Base
  assert(not engine.Accounts[a.Id],"Duplicate saved account")
  engine.Accounts[a.Id]=account table.insert(engine.AccountOrder,a.Id)
 end
 for key,fields in pairs(data.Books)do for name,value in pairs(fields)do engine.Books[key][name]=clone(value)end end
 engine.Profiles=clone(data.Profiles or {})
 for uid,profile in pairs(engine.Profiles)do
  assert(type(uid)=="string"and type(profile)=="table"and type(profile.Tiers)=="table"and type(profile.Ledger)=="table","Invalid saved funded profile")
  for _,id in ipairs(profile.Ledger)do assert(engine.Accounts[id],"Saved funded account missing")end
 end
 local prior=0
 for _,order in ipairs(data.Orders)do
  local o=clone(order)
  assert(o.Id>prior and o.Remaining>0 and engine.Accounts[o.Owner]and engine.Books[o.Contract],"Invalid saved resting order")
  prior=o.Id engine.Orders[o.Id]=o engine.Accounts[o.Owner].OpenOrders[o.Id]=true
  -- Armed stop entries and player limits are not book liquidity; the engine rebuilds both indexes from
  -- Orders. Only participant orders rest in the book, so saved player limits migrate off-book here.
  if o.Type~="Stop" and not engine.Accounts[o.Owner].Player then engine:_rest(engine.Books[o.Contract],o) end
 end
 local population=setmetatable({Engine=engine,Config=config},Participants)
 for key,value in pairs(snapshot.Population)do if key~="RandomState"then population[key]=clone(value)end end
 population.Random=Participants.RNG.new(1);population.Random.State=snapshot.Population.RandomState
 assert(type(population.Random.State)=="number"and population.Random.State>0 and population.Random.State<2147483647,"Invalid saved random state")
 for _,agent in ipairs(population.Agents)do assert(engine.Accounts[agent.Id],"Saved participant account missing")end
 if snapshot.Version<3 then
  local currentAccounts={}
  for _,profile in pairs(engine.Profiles) do for _,entry in pairs(profile.Tiers) do if entry.Account then currentAccounts[entry.Account]=true end end end
  for _,profile in pairs(engine.Profiles) do for _,id in ipairs(profile.Ledger) do if not currentAccounts[id] then engine.Accounts[id].Retired=true end end end
  for _,id in ipairs(engine.AccountOrder) do
   local a=engine.Accounts[id]
   if a.Player and not a.Retired and engine:Summary(a).Equity>0 then
    a.Locked=false a.Liquidating=nil
    for _,p in pairs(a.Positions) do if p.Triggered=="Risk liquidation" then p.Triggered=nil end end
   end
   if a.Player then
    for orderId in pairs(clone(a.OpenOrders)) do
     local o=engine.Orders[orderId]
     if config.Contracts[o.Contract].CloseOnly and not o.ReduceOnly then engine:Cancel(id,orderId) end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 -- A market that became close-only keeps its positions, SL/TP and closing orders. Its entry orders could only
 -- open new exposure there, so they are cancelled (the order history records it).
 if next(retiring) then
  for _,id in ipairs(engine.AccountOrder) do
   local a=engine.Accounts[id]
   if a.Player then
    local ids={} for orderId in pairs(a.OpenOrders) do table.insert(ids,orderId) end table.sort(ids)
    for _,orderId in ipairs(ids) do
     local o=engine.Orders[orderId]
     if o and retiring[o.Contract] and not o.ReduceOnly then engine:Cancel(id,orderId) end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 for _,key in ipairs(order) do if added[key] then population:AddMarket(key) end end
 -- Lifetime trading stats (no format change): rebuilt once from saved history for older accounts,
 -- reconciled against the ledger for all others. Idempotent across repeated restores.
 local now=os.time()
 for _,id in ipairs(engine.AccountOrder) do local a=engine.Accounts[id] if a.Player then TradeStats.Reconcile(engine,a,now) end end
 -- Required migration, not optional leaderboard work: any failure aborts restore before saving.
 require(script.Parent.FundedAccounts).new(engine,require(game.ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.ProgressionConfig),currentConfig)
 engine:Audit()
 return engine,population
end
-- The reader's decompressed-size bound. It is unchanged, so every checkpoint that opened before still opens.
-- Encode refuses anything larger before compressing, so the writer and the reader enforce one bound: every
-- checkpoint the writer accepts decodes, and every save that decodes today can be written again.
Checkpoint.MaxDecodedBytes=32000000
-- The reader's header rules, shared by Encode (before a commit) and Decode (on restore).
function Checkpoint.Check(record,maxDecodedBytes)
 assert(type(record)=="table" and Checkpoint.Readable[record.Version] and record.Codec=="zstd-base64" and type(record.Payload)=="string","Invalid checkpoint encoding")
 local compressed=Encoding:Base64Decode(buffer.fromstring(record.Payload))
 local bytes=Encoding:GetDecompressedBufferSize(compressed,Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd)
 assert(bytes and bytes==record.RawBytes and bytes<=math.min(maxDecodedBytes or Checkpoint.MaxDecodedBytes,Checkpoint.MaxDecodedBytes),"Invalid checkpoint length")
 return compressed,bytes
end
function Checkpoint.Encode(snapshot,maxRawBytes)
 local raw=Http:JSONEncode(snapshot)
 local limit=math.min(maxRawBytes or Checkpoint.MaxDecodedBytes,Checkpoint.MaxDecodedBytes)
 if #raw>limit then error(string.format("Exchange checkpoint is too large (%d raw bytes, limit %d); trading paused to protect saved state",#raw,limit),2) end

local function money(v)

 local sign=v<0 and "-" or ""

end

function Kit.BindDropdown(root,trigger,items,selectedKey,onChoose)

 local previousSelection
 local api={}
 local function caption()
  for _,item in ipairs(items)do if item.Key==selected then setText(trigger,trigger.Name.."Label",item.Label);return end end
 end
 function api:Close()
  opened=false

  if previousSelection and previousSelection.Parent then GuiService.SelectedObject=previousSelection end
  previousSelection=nil
 end
 function api:Set(key)selected=key;caption()end
 function api:Choose(key)
  local exists=false;for _,item in ipairs(items)do if item.Key==key then exists=true end end
  if not exists then return false end

  if accepted then self:Set(key)end

 end

  if self:IsOpen() then self:Close();return end

  local old=root:FindFirstChild("DropdownOverlay");if old then old:Destroy()end
  opened=true;previousSelection=root:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("PlayerGui")and GuiService.SelectedObject or nil

  overlay.Activated:Connect(function()self:Close()end)
  local scale=root.Size.X.Offset>0 and root.AbsoluteSize.X/root.Size.X.Offset or 1
