ServerScriptService.MarketReign.TradeSta:
-- Authoritative lifetime trading statistics, stored on each player account inside the exchange checkpoint.
-- A "completed trade" is one closing execution: exactly one row of the account's Trade History. A partial
-- close records the contracts it closed; the rest count when they close. A reversal counts its closing part.
-- Counters are updated by MarketEngine on the same execution that changes Balance/Realized, so they save and
-- restore atomically with the ledger. Display history is bounded (MaxAccountHistory); these counters are not.
local Stats={Version=1,EvenCents=0}
local EPS=0.005 -- half a cent: reconciliation tolerance for floating-point P&L

-- Calendar days are [00:00:00, 24:00:00) UTC, from the server's close timestamp.
-- Simulation HH:MM:SS is deliberately never treated as a historical calendar date.
local function dayRow()
 return {Trades=0,Wins=0,Losses=0,Even=0,Gains=0,Loss=0,Net=0}
end
function Stats.TrackDay(s,row)
 local stamp=row.ClosedAt
 if type(stamp)=="number" and stamp==stamp and stamp>0 and stamp<1e12 then
  local key=tostring(math.floor(stamp/86400))
  local d=s.Days[key] or dayRow() s.Days[key]=d
  local pnl=row.Pnl or 0 local cents=math.round(pnl*100)
  d.Trades+=1 d.Net+=pnl
  if cents>0 then d.Wins+=1 elseif cents<0 then d.Losses+=1 else d.Even+=1 end
  if pnl>0 then d.Gains+=pnl elseif pnl<0 then d.Loss-=pnl end
  d.Best=math.max(d.Best or pnl,pnl) d.Worst=math.min(d.Worst or pnl,pnl)
  s.FirstClosedAt=math.min(s.FirstClosedAt or stamp,stamp)
 end
 s.DayLastTradeId=math.max(s.DayLastTradeId or 0,row.TradeId or 0)
end
function Stats.EnsureDays(s,rows)
 if s.DayV~=1 then s.DayV=1 s.Days={} s.DayLastTradeId=0 end
 -- Also repairs dates retained after an older server updated lifetime counters but not days.
 local last=s.DayLastTradeId or 0
 for i=#(rows or {}),1,-1 do local row=rows[i]
  if type(row.TradeId)=="number" and row.TradeId>last and row.TradeId<=(s.LastTradeId or 0) then Stats.TrackDay(s,row) end
 end
end

function Stats.New(origin,now)
 return {V=Stats.Version,Trades=0,Wins=0,Losses=0,Even=0,Gains=0,Loss=0,Best=nil,Worst=nil,LastTradeId=0,
  UntrackedNet=0,UntrackedTrades=0,CountUnknown=false,Origin=origin or "Live",Since=now,DayV=1,Days={},DayLastTradeId=0}
end
-- Classify by the cent: a result that rounds to $0.00 is break-even. Sums use the exact values so that
-- Gains - Loss equals the ledger's realized total.
function Stats.Add(s,row)
 Stats.EnsureDays(s)
 Stats.TrackDay(s,row)
 local pnl=row.Pnl or 0
 local cents=math.round(pnl*100)
 s.Trades+=1
 if cents>Stats.EvenCents then s.Wins+=1 elseif cents<-Stats.EvenCents then s.Losses+=1 else s.Even+=1 end
 if pnl>0 then s.Gains+=pnl elseif pnl<0 then s.Loss-=pnl end
 if s.Best==nil or pnl>s.Best then s.Best=pnl end
 if s.Worst==nil or pnl<s.Worst then s.Worst=pnl end
 if type(row.TradeId)=="number" and row.TradeId>s.LastTradeId then s.LastTradeId=row.TradeId end
end
function Stats.Tracked(s) return s.Gains-s.Loss end

-- Depletion is recorded per attempt, once. New executions set Depleted when the engine latches Locked at
-- $0 equity. Saved attempts from before this marker existed are classified from their final state.
function Stats.MarkDepletion(engine,a)
 -- An archive record aggregates many finished attempts; each was classified before it was folded.
 if a.Archive or a.MigrationArchived or a.Depleted or a.Breached or not a.Locked or not a.Player then return end
 local equity=engine:Summary(a).Equity
 -- Checkpoint v3 reopened every positive-equity account that older loss rules had locked, so a current
 -- (not retired) locked account is depleted. A retired attempt still holding most of its capital was
 -- restarted under the earlier loss-limit rules and is reported separately, not as blown.
 if equity<=0 or not a.Retired or a.Balance<=a.Base*0.5 then a.Depleted=true
 else a.Breached="Earlier loss limit" end
end

-- Idempotent migration + drift repair. Safe to call on every restore.
--  * Accounts without Stats are rebuilt from their saved Trade History. When the rows reconcile with the
--    ledger (realized total, and the completed-trade counter when present) and the history was never trimmed,
--    the rebuild is complete ("Recovered"). Otherwise the unmatched part is kept as an untracked remainder
--    ("Partial") so Net realized still equals the ledger, and the UI labels the breakdown period.
--  * Accounts with Stats pick up any retained rows newer than LastTradeId (e.g. written by an older server
--    build), and any remaining mismatch is moved into the untracked remainder. Nothing is ever counted twice.
function Stats.Reconcile(engine,a,now)
 if not a.Player then return nil end
 local max=engine.Config.MaxAccountHistory or 60
 local rows=a.History or {}
 local s=a.Stats local fresh=type(s)~="table" or s.V~=Stats.Version
 if fresh then s=Stats.New("Recovered",now) a.Stats=s end
 Stats.EnsureDays(s,rows)
 -- History is newest first. Skip the scan when the newest row is already counted.
 local newest=rows[1]
 if fresh or (newest and type(newest.TradeId)=="number" and newest.TradeId>s.LastTradeId) then
  for i=#rows,1,-1 do
   local h=rows[i]
   if fresh or (type(h.TradeId)=="number" and h.TradeId>s.LastTradeId) then Stats.Add(s,h) end
  end
 end
 local gap=a.Realized-(Stats.Tracked(s)+s.UntrackedNet)
 local ledger=a.CompletedTrades
 if fresh then
  local trimmed=#rows>=max
  local countKnown=(ledger==nil and not trimmed) or ledger==s.Trades
  if math.abs(gap)<EPS and countKnown then
   s.Origin=#rows>0 and "Recovered" or "Live"
   -- The completed-trade counter predates some saves; a complete rebuild makes it exact.
   if ledger==nil and s.Trades>0 then a.CompletedTrades=s.Trades end
  else
   s.Origin="Partial" s.PartialSince=now
   s.UntrackedNet=gap
   s.UntrackedTrades=math.max(0,(ledger or #rows)-s.Trades)
   -- A counter that started from an already-trimmed history can itself undercount. Say so.
   s.CountUnknown=trimmed and ledger~=s.Trades
  end
 else
  if math.abs(gap)>=EPS then s.UntrackedNet+=gap s.Origin="Partial" s.PartialSince=s.PartialSince or now end
  local counted=s.Trades+s.UntrackedTrades
  if ledger and ledger>counted then s.UntrackedTrades+=ledger-counted s.Origin="Partial" s.PartialSince=s.PartialSince or now end
 end
 Stats.MarkDepletion(engine,a)
 return s
end

-- Folds one finished attempt's lifetime counters into an archive record. Every field is additive or an
-- extreme (best/worst, first/last), so the archive reports exactly what the separate attempts reported.
function Stats.Merge(into,s)
 Stats.EnsureDays(into) Stats.EnsureDays(s)
 for _,k in ipairs({"Trades","Wins","Losses","Even","Gains","Loss","UntrackedNet","UntrackedTrades"}) do into[k]+=s[k] or 0 end
 if s.Best~=nil and (into.Best==nil or s.Best>into.Best) then into.Best=s.Best end
 if s.Worst~=nil and (into.Worst==nil or s.Worst<into.Worst) then into.Worst=s.Worst end
 into.LastTradeId=math.max(into.LastTradeId or 0,s.LastTradeId or 0)
 into.DayLastTradeId=math.max(into.DayLastTradeId or 0,s.DayLastTradeId or 0)
 for key,day in pairs(s.Days) do
  local d=into.Days[key] or dayRow() into.Days[key]=d
  for _,k in ipairs({"Trades","Wins","Losses","Even","Gains","Loss","Net"}) do d[k]+=day[k] end
  if day.Best then d.Best=math.max(d.Best or day.Best,day.Best) end
  if day.Worst then d.Worst=math.min(d.Worst or day.Worst,day.Worst) end
 end
 if s.FirstClosedAt then into.FirstClosedAt=math.min(into.FirstClosedAt or s.FirstClosedAt,s.FirstClosedAt) end
 if s.Since then into.Since=math.min(into.Since or s.Since,s.Since) end
 into.CountUnknown=into.CountUnknown==true or s.CountUnknown==true
 into.RecoveredAny=into.RecoveredAny or s.RecoveredAny or s.Origin=="Recovered" or nil
 if s.Origin=="Partial" then
  into.Origin="Partial"
  if s.PartialSince then into.PartialSince=math.min(into.PartialSince or s.PartialSince,s.PartialSince) end
 elseif into.Origin~="Partial" and into.RecoveredAny then into.Origin="Recovered" end
 return into
end
-- Aggregation used by every Stats scope. Open P&L comes from the live engine summary of open positions.
function Stats.Empty()
 return {Attempts=0,Blown=0,Breached=0,Trades=0,Wins=0,Losses=0,Even=0,Gains=0,Loss=0,Net=0,Open=0,
  UntrackedNet=0,UntrackedTrades=0,CountUnknown=false,Partial=false,Recovered=false,Since=nil,Days={}}
end
function Stats.Include(agg,engine,a)
 local s=a.Stats or Stats.Reconcile(engine,a,os.time())
 Stats.EnsureDays(s,a.History)
 for key,day in pairs(s.Days) do
  local d=agg.Days[key] or dayRow() agg.Days[key]=d
  for _,k in ipairs({"Trades","Wins","Losses","Even","Gains","Loss","Net"}) do d[k]+=day[k] end
  if day.Best then d.Best=math.max(d.Best or day.Best,day.Best) end
  if day.Worst then d.Worst=math.min(d.Worst or day.Worst,day.Worst) end
 end
 if s.FirstClosedAt then agg.FirstClosedAt=math.min(agg.FirstClosedAt or s.FirstClosedAt,s.FirstClosedAt) end
 if a.Archive then
  -- Folded finished attempts keep their own attempt/blown/breached classification.
  agg.Attempts+=a.Archive.Attempts agg.Blown+=a.Archive.Blown agg.Breached+=a.Archive.Breached
 else
  agg.Attempts+=1
  if a.Depleted then agg.Blown+=1 elseif a.Breached then agg.Breached+=1 end
 end
 if s.RecoveredAny then agg.Recovered=true end
 for _,k in ipairs({"Trades","Wins","Losses","Even","Gains","Loss","UntrackedNet","UntrackedTrades"}) do agg[k]+=s[k] end
 agg.Net+=a.Realized
 if not a.Retired then agg.Open+=engine:Summary(a).Unrealized end
 if s.Best~=nil and (agg.Best==nil or s.Best>agg.Best) then agg.Best=s.Best end
 if s.Worst~=nil and (agg.Worst==nil or s.Worst<agg.Worst) then agg.Worst=s.Worst end
 if s.Origin=="Partial" then
  agg.Partial=true agg.CountUnknown=agg.CountUnknown or s.CountUnknown
  if s.PartialSince and (agg.Since==nil or s.PartialSince<agg.Since) then agg.Since=s.PartialSince end
 elseif s.Origin=="Recovered" then agg.Recovered=true end
 return agg
end
-- Derived values, computed once on the server so every client shows the same numbers.
function Stats.Finish(agg,datedOnly)
 if math.abs(agg.UntrackedNet)<EPS then agg.UntrackedNet=0 end
 agg.Total=agg.Net+agg.Open
 agg.WinRate=agg.Trades>0 and agg.Wins/agg.Trades or nil
 agg.AllTrades=agg.Trades+agg.UntrackedTrades
 if not agg.CountUnknown and agg.AllTrades>0 then agg.Average=agg.Net/agg.AllTrades agg.AverageScope="All"
 elseif agg.Trades>0 then agg.Average=(agg.Gains-agg.Loss)/agg.Trades agg.AverageScope="Tracked" end
 agg.AvgWin=agg.Wins>0 and agg.Gains/agg.Wins or nil
 agg.AvgLoss=agg.Losses>0 and agg.Loss/agg.Losses or nil
 agg.WinLossRatio=agg.AvgLoss and agg.AvgLoss>0 and (agg.AvgWin or 0)/agg.AvgLoss or nil
 agg.ProfitFactor=agg.Loss>0 and agg.Gains/agg.Loss or nil
 agg.NoLosses=agg.Trades>0 and agg.Gains>0 and agg.Loss==0
 local dated=Stats.Empty() local days,wins,lossDays,dayTrades,best=0,0,0,0,nil
 for _,day in pairs(agg.Days or {}) do
  days+=1 dayTrades+=day.Trades
  if math.round(day.Net*100)>0 then wins+=1 end
  if math.round(day.Net*100)<0 then lossDays+=1 end
  best=math.max(best or day.Net,day.Net)
  for _,k in ipairs({"Trades","Wins","Losses","Even","Gains","Loss","Net"}) do dated[k]+=day[k] end
 end
 agg.UndatedTrades=math.max(0,agg.AllTrades-dayTrades)
 agg.DayCount=days agg.WinningDays=wins agg.LosingDays=lossDays agg.BestDay=best
 agg.DailyComplete=agg.UndatedTrades==0 and not agg.CountUnknown and not agg.Partial
 agg.DayWinRate=agg.DailyComplete and days>0 and wins/days or nil
 agg.BestDayShare=agg.DailyComplete and best and best>0 and agg.Net>=EPS and best/agg.Net or nil
 if not datedOnly then
  dated.Days=agg.Days dated.FirstClosedAt=agg.FirstClosedAt
  dated.Attempts=agg.Attempts dated.Blown=agg.Blown dated.Breached=agg.Breached
  agg.Dated=Stats.Finish(dated,true)
 end
 -- Day buckets remain on the saved account; only compact derived results cross the network.
 agg.Days=nil
 return agg
end
return Stats
ServerScriptService.MarketReign.Leaderbo:
-- This game persists EVERY funded profile in one fenced shared-exchange checkpoint.
-- Publish a complete top-100 projection, atomically, instead of racing per-user ordered writes.
-- A lower score can evict a previous winner correctly; ties at the cutoff are deterministic.
local Ranking=require(script.Parent.LeaderboardRanking)
local Service={} Service.__index=Service
Service.RefreshSeconds=45
function Service.Scope(studio) return studio and "Studio" or "Live" end
function Service.new(options)
 options=options or {}
 return setmetatable({Store=options.Store,Studio=options.Studio,Now=options.Now or os.time,
  Cache=nil,ReadAt=0,NextRead=0,NextWrite=0,Pending=nil,Reading=false,Writing=false,Failures=0},Service)
end
function Service:_store()
 if not self.Store then self.Store=game:GetService("DataStoreService"):GetDataStore("GetFunded_Leaderboard_v1",Service.Scope(self.Studio)) end
 return self.Store
end
function Service:Queue(projection)
 if not projection or self.LastProjection==projection then return end
 self.LastProjection=projection
 if not self.Pending or projection.WorldId~=self.Pending.WorldId or projection.Sequence>self.Pending.Sequence then self.Pending=projection end
end
function Service:Flush()
 local pending=self.Pending
 if self.Writing or not pending or self.Now()<self.NextWrite then return false end
 self.Writing=true
 local ok,result=pcall(function()
  return self:_store():UpdateAsync("top100",function(old)
   if old then
    assert(old.Version==1 and old.WorldId==pending.WorldId,"Leaderboard belongs to another exchange")
    if old.Sequence>=pending.Sequence then return nil end -- fences delayed/stale writers, including losses
   end
   return {Version=1,WorldId=pending.WorldId,Sequence=pending.Sequence,SavedAt=pending.SavedAt,Rows=pending.Rows}
  end)
 end)
 self.Writing=false
 if ok then
  self.Failures=0;self.WriteError=nil;self.NextWrite=self.Now()+Service.RefreshSeconds
  if self.Pending==pending then self.Pending=nil end
  if result then
   -- An overlapping read may already have seen the next owner's newer snapshot.
   if not self.Cache or (result.WorldId==self.Cache.WorldId and result.Sequence>=self.Cache.Sequence)then
    self.Cache=result;self.ReadAt=self.Now();self.NextRead=self.Now()+Service.RefreshSeconds;self.ReadError=nil
   end
  else self.NextRead=0 end
 else
  self.Failures+=1;self.WriteError=tostring(result)
  self.NextWrite=self.Now()+math.min(45,5*2^math.min(self.Failures-1,4))
 end
 return ok
end
function Service:Read()
 local now=self.Now()
 if self.Reading or now<self.NextRead then return self.Cache end
 self.Reading=true;self.NextRead=now+Service.RefreshSeconds
 local ok,record=pcall(function()return self:_store():GetAsync("top100")end)
 self.Reading=false
 if ok and record and (record.Version~=1 or type(record.Rows)~="table" or type(record.SavedAt)~="number" or type(record.Sequence)~="number") then ok=false;record="Invalid leaderboard snapshot" end
 if ok then
  -- Do not regress a cache if a read overlaps a newer successful publish.
  if not record then if not self.Cache then self.ReadAt=now end
  elseif not self.Cache or (record.WorldId==self.Cache.WorldId and record.Sequence>=self.Cache.Sequence) then self.Cache=record;self.ReadAt=now end
  self.ReadError=nil
 else self.ReadError=tostring(record);self.NextRead=now+10 end
 return self.Cache
end
function Service:Names(rows)
 self.NameCache=self.NameCache or {};self.NameRetry=self.NameRetry or 0
 local missing={}
 for _,row in ipairs(rows) do
  local cached=self.NameCache[row.UserId]
  if cached then row.Name=cached.Name;row.DisplayName=cached.DisplayName
  elseif not row.Name and row.UserId>0 then table.insert(missing,row.UserId) end
 end
 if #missing==0 or self.Now()<self.NameRetry then return end
 self.NameRetry=self.Now()+60
 local ok,infos=pcall(function()return game:GetService("UserService"):GetUserInfosByUserIdsAsync(missing)end)
 if ok then
  for _,info in ipairs(infos) do self.NameCache[info.Id]={Name=info.Username,DisplayName=info.DisplayName} end
  for _,row in ipairs(rows)do local info=self.NameCache[row.UserId];if info then row.Name=info.Name;row.DisplayName=info.DisplayName end end
 end
end
function Service:Global(own)
 self:Read()
 local record=self.Cache
 local stale=record and (self.Now()-record.SavedAt>120 or self.ReadError~=nil or self.WriteError~=nil)
 local rows={}
 for _,r in ipairs(record and record.Rows or {}) do
  local row=table.clone(r);if stale then row.Rank=nil end;table.insert(rows,row)
 end
 self:Names(rows)
 local state=not record and (self.ReadError and "Error" or "Loading") or stale and "Stale" or #rows==0 and "Empty" or "Ready"
 return {Tab="Global",State=state,Rows=rows,Your=Ranking.Standing(own,rows,record~=nil and not stale),
  SavedAt=record and record.SavedAt,RefreshSeconds=Service.RefreshSeconds,Studio=self.Studio==true}
end
function Service:Server(funded,players,player)
 local rows={}
 for _,p in ipairs(players) do table.insert(rows,Ranking.Row(funded,tostring(p.UserId),p)) end
 rows=Ranking.Sort(rows)
 local own=Ranking.Standing(Ranking.Row(funded,tostring(player.UserId),player),rows,true)
 return {Tab="Server",State=#rows==0 and "Empty" or "Ready",Rows=rows,Your=own,RefreshSeconds=10,Studio=self.Studio==true}
end
return Service

-- Pure projection of the authoritative funded ledger. Never accepts client scores.
local Ranking={Limit=100}
function Ranking.Row(funded,uid,identity)
 local p=funded:Profile(uid)
 local row={UserId=tonumber(uid),Name=identity and identity.Name or p and p.PlayerName,
  DisplayName=identity and identity.DisplayName or p and p.DisplayName,Cents=0,Eligible=false,Tier="—",TierSize=0}
 if not row.UserId or row.UserId%1~=0 then return nil end
 if not p then return row end
 local profit=funded:Earned(p)
 assert(profit==profit and math.abs(profit)<9e13,"Invalid funded profit")
 row.Cents=math.round(profit*100)
 local trades=funded:_counts(p)
 row.Eligible=trades>0
 row.Tier=p.Rank or "New Trader";row.TierSize=0
 return row
end
function Ranking.Sort(rows,limit)
 local result,seen={},{}
 for _,row in ipairs(rows) do
  if row and row.Eligible and not seen[row.UserId] then seen[row.UserId]=true;table.insert(result,table.clone(row)) end
 end
 table.sort(result,function(a,b) if a.Cents~=b.Cents then return a.Cents>b.Cents end return a.UserId<b.UserId end)
 while limit and #result>limit do table.remove(result) end
 for i,row in ipairs(result) do row.Rank=i end
 return result
end
function Ranking.Capture(funded)
 local rows={}
 for uid in pairs(funded.Engine.Profiles) do
  local row=Ranking.Row(funded,uid)
  -- Studio's synthetic negative user ids are allowed only by its separate store scope.
  if row then table.insert(rows,row) end
 end
 return Ranking.Sort(rows,Ranking.Limit)
end
function Ranking.Standing(own,rows,verified)
 own=table.clone(own);own.Rank=nil
 if not own.Eligible then own.Status="Complete a trade to join";return own end
 own.Status="Outside top 100"
 if verified then
  for _,row in ipairs(rows) do
   if row.UserId==own.UserId and row.Cents==own.Cents then own.Rank=row.Rank;own.Status="#"..row.Rank;break end
  end
 end
 return own
end
return Ranking
ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.StatsChart:
-- Smooth, transparent native rings. Circular strokes keep the inner/outer curves concentric;
-- a radial half-plane cuts each coloured prefix at the exact statistical angle.
-- No uploaded textures, pixel wedges, tessellation seams, or opaque centre masks.
local Charts={}
function Charts.Draw(ctx,parent,name,cx,cy,radius,thickness,win,loss,half,colors)
 local container=ctx.frame(parent,name,cx-radius-thickness/2-2,cy-radius-thickness/2-2,
  radius*2+thickness+4,(half and radius or radius*2)+thickness+4,colors.Neutral,4)
 container.BackgroundTransparency=1
 local margin=thickness/2+2 local center=radius+margin
 win=win and math.clamp(win,0,1) or nil
 loss=win and math.clamp(loss or 0,0,1-win) or 0
 container:SetAttribute("Renderer","CircularStroke")
 container:SetAttribute("WinShare",win)
 container:SetAttribute("LossShare",loss)
 container:SetAttribute("NeutralShare",win and math.max(0,1-win-loss) or 1)
 container:SetAttribute("Thickness",thickness)
 container:SetAttribute("ArcDegrees",half and 180 or 360)
 local function layer(label,color,share,z,side)
  if share<=0 then return end
  local clip=ctx.frame(container,label,side=="Right"and center or 0,0,
   half and center*2 or center,half and center or center*2,color,z)
  clip.BackgroundTransparency=1 clip.ClipsDescendants=true
  local disk=ctx.frame(clip,"Circle",side=="Right"and -radius or margin,margin,radius*2,radius*2,color,z)
  disk.BackgroundTransparency=1 ctx.round(disk,radius)
  local stroke=ctx.stroke(disk,color) stroke.Thickness=thickness stroke.BorderStrokePosition=Enum.BorderStrokePosition.Center
  if share<1 then
   local rotation=half and 90-share*180 or (side=="Right"and share*180 or 180+share*180)
   local cut=Instance.new("UIGradient") cut.Name="RadialBoundary" cut.Rotation=rotation
   local first,last=half and 1 or 0,half and 0 or 1
   cut.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,first),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.4995,first),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.5005,last),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,last)})
   cut.Parent=stroke
  end
 end
 local function prefix(label,color,share,z)
  if half then layer(label,color,share,z,"Top")
  else
   layer(label.."Right",color,math.clamp(share*2,0,1),z,"Right")
   layer(label.."Left",color,math.clamp(share*2-1,0,1),z,"Left")
  end
 end
 prefix("Track",colors.Neutral,1,4)
 if win then
  prefix("Loss",colors.Loss,win+loss,5)
  prefix("Win",colors.Win,win,6)
 end
 return container
end
return Charts
ReplicatedStorage.MarketReign.StatsView:
-- Stats page: trading performance for the current account. Every number is computed and
-- persisted by the server (TradeStats / FundedAccounts:Stats). Only Stats content is drawn here, using
-- individual editable components from 06 - Polished Stats Pieces. TerminalUI owns all shared navigation.
local TextService=game:GetService("TextService")
local Kit=require(script.Parent.StatsPieces)
local View={}
local LEFT,CENTER,RIGHT=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
local TOP=Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
local AtEnd=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
local FONT=Enum.Font.FredokaOne

local function commas(n)
 local raw=tostring(math.floor(math.abs(n or 0)+0.5))
 return ((n or 0)<0 and "-" or "")..raw:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)","%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,","")
end
local function plural(n,word) return commas(n).." "..word..(n==1 and "" or "s") end
local function pct(rate) return rate and string.format("%.1f%%",rate*100) or "—" end
local function measure(value,size,width) return TextService:GetTextSize(value,size,FONT,Vector2.new(math.max(1,width),10000)).Y end
View.Commas=commas

-- Always use the current account, including when an older UI state selected another period.

function View.Resolve(data,state,portfolio)

local Pool=require(script.Parent.ChartPaintPool)
return function()
 local root=Instance.new("Frame") local pool=Pool.new(root)
 local ok,result=pcall(function()
  local function mark(x,identity,animate)
   pool:Begin(animate)
   local object=pool:Get("Frame","Candle",root)
   pool:Props(object,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(8,20)},identity)
   pool:Finish();return object
  end
  local candle=mark(0,60,false)
  assert(mark(0,60,true)==candle and #root:GetChildren()==1,"Unchanged paint must reuse its object")
  mark(100,60,true);assert(candle.Position.X.Offset==0,"Animation must start at the existing geometry")
  pool:Step(.02);assert(candle.Position.X.Offset>0 and candle.Position.X.Offset<100,"Intermediate geometry expected")
  pool:Step(.06);assert(candle.Position.X.Offset==100 and not next(pool.Moving),"Must settle exactly on the target")
  mark(200,60,true);pool:Step(.02)
  mark(300,120,true);assert(candle.Position.X.Offset==300,"Never animate a reused slot from a different candle")
  mark(400,120,true);pool:Step(.01);mark(450,120,false)
  assert(candle.Position.X.Offset==450 and not next(pool.Moving),"Dragging must follow the pointer without tween lag")
  mark(500,120,true);pool:Step(.01);pool:Begin(true);pool:Finish()
  assert(not candle.Visible)
  mark(500,120,true);assert(candle.Visible and candle.Position.X.Offset==500,"Hidden animation cannot resume with stale geometry")
  pool:Begin(false);local row=pool:Dash(root,0,30,600,Color3.new(1,1,1),5,3);pool:Finish()
  local count=#root:GetDescendants();local first=row:GetChildren()[1];local position=first.Position
  pool:Begin(false);local same=pool:Dash(root,0,80,600,Color3.new(1,1,1),5,3);pool:Finish()
  assert(row==same and #root:GetDescendants()==count and first.Position==position and row.Position.Y.Offset==80,"Dash movement must move only the parent")
  pool:Begin(false);pool:Dash(root,0,80,300,Color3.new(1,1,1),5,3);pool:Finish()
  local visible=0 for _,child in ipairs(row:GetChildren())do if child.Visible then visible+=1 end end
  assert(visible==30,"Resizing must hide surplus dashes")

  local keyed=Pool.new(root)

   keyed:Begin(false) local out={}
   for _,t in ipairs(times)do out[t]=keyed:Get("Frame","KeyedCandle",root,t)end
   keyed:Finish() return out
  end
  local a=draw({60,120,180}) local b=draw({120,180,240})
  assert(a[120]==b[120] and a[180]==b[180] and b[240]~=a[60],"Keyed objects follow their identity")
  assert(not a[60].Visible and b[240].Visible,"Keyed objects out of view are hidden")

-- Retained chart primitives: unchanged properties never invalidate Roblox's GUI layout.
-- Only candle geometry animates; execution prices and candle data remain authoritative.
local Pool={} Pool.__index=Pool
function Pool.new(root)
 return setmetatable({Root=root,Parents={},Objects={},Entries={},Moving={},Epoch=0,CanAnimate=false,Duration=0.08},Pool)
end
function Pool:Begin(animate)
 self.Epoch+=1 self.CanAnimate=animate==true
 if not self.CanAnimate then self:Snap() end
 for _,bucket in pairs(self.Parents)do table.clear(bucket.Counts)end
end
-- Without an identity, objects are reused by draw order. With one (a candle's time), the same
-- candle always owns the same objects, so panning can never hand a candle another candle's paint.
function Pool:Get(class,name,parent,identity)
 local bucket=self.Parents[parent]
 if not bucket then bucket={Counts={},Lists={},Keyed={}} self.Parents[parent]=bucket end
 local key=class..":"..name local entry
 if identity~=nil then
  local keyed=bucket.Keyed[key] if not keyed then keyed={} bucket.Keyed[key]=keyed end
  entry=keyed[identity]
  if not entry then
   local object=Instance.new(class) object.Name=name object.Parent=parent
   entry={Object=object,Values={},Gui=object:IsA("GuiObject"),Stroke=class=="UIStroke",Motion={},Keyed=keyed,Identity=identity,Key=identity}
   keyed[identity]=entry self.Entries[object]=entry table.insert(self.Objects,entry)
  end
 else
 local index=(bucket.Counts[key]or 0)+1 bucket.Counts[key]=index
 local list=bucket.Lists[key] if not list then list={} bucket.Lists[key]=list end
 entry=list[index]
 if not entry then
  local object=Instance.new(class) object.Name=name object.Parent=parent
  entry={Object=object,Values={},Gui=object:IsA("GuiObject"),Stroke=class=="UIStroke",Motion={}}
  list[index]=entry self.Entries[object]=entry table.insert(self.Objects,entry)
 end
 end
 entry.Epoch=self.Epoch
 if entry.Gui and not entry.Object.Visible then entry.Object.Visible=true
 elseif entry.Stroke and not entry.Object.Enabled then entry.Object.Enabled=true end
 entry.Active=true
 return entry.Object
end
function Pool:Props(object,props,identity)
 local entry=self.Entries[object]
 local animate=self.CanAnimate and identity~=nil and identity==entry.Identity
 if identity~=entry.Identity then
  for key in pairs(entry.Motion)do entry.Values[key]=nil end
  table.clear(entry.Motion) self.Moving[entry]=nil
 end
 entry.Identity=identity
 for key,value in pairs(props)do
  if entry.Values[key]~=value then
   entry.Values[key]=value
   if animate and(key=="Position"or key=="Size")then
    entry.Motion[key]={From=object[key],To=value,Elapsed=0} self.Moving[entry]=true
   else object[key]=value end
  end
 end
end
function Pool:Step(dt)
 for entry in pairs(self.Moving)do
  for key,motion in pairs(entry.Motion)do
   motion.Elapsed=math.min(self.Duration,motion.Elapsed+dt)
   local t=motion.Elapsed/self.Duration local alpha=1-(1-t)^3
   entry.Object[key]=motion.From:Lerp(motion.To,alpha)
   if t>=1 then entry.Motion[key]=nil end
  end
  if not next(entry.Motion)then self.Moving[entry]=nil end
 end
end
function Pool:Snap()
 for entry in pairs(self.Moving)do
  for key,motion in pairs(entry.Motion)do entry.Object[key]=motion.To end
  table.clear(entry.Motion)
 end
 table.clear(self.Moving)
end
-- `thickness` (default 1 px) is centred on y. Segments are sized to stay inside the row, so the row does
-- not clip: clipping a 1 px-tall row could round to an empty rectangle and hide the whole line.
function Pool:Dash(parent,x,y,width,color,length,z,thickness)
 thickness=thickness or 1
 local row=self:Get("Frame","DashedLineRow",parent)
 self:Props(row,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y-(thickness-1)//2),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(width,thickness),BackgroundTransparency=1,
  BorderSizePixel=0,ClipsDescendants=false,ZIndex=z or parent.ZIndex})
 local entry=self.Entries[row]
 -- Move a whole dash row with one property write, not hundreds of separate segments.
 if entry.Width~=width or entry.Color~=color or entry.Length~=length or entry.Z~=z or entry.T~=thickness then
  entry.Width=width entry.Color=color entry.Length=length entry.Z=z entry.T=thickness entry.Dashes=entry.Dashes or{}
  local count=math.ceil(width/(length+5))
  for i=1,math.max(count,#entry.Dashes)do
   local mark=entry.Dashes[i]
   if not mark then mark=Instance.new("Frame");mark.Name="DashedLine";mark.BorderSizePixel=0;mark.Parent=row;entry.Dashes[i]=mark end
   mark.Visible=i<=count
   if i<=count then
    local offset=(i-1)*(length+5)
    mark.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(offset,0);mark.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(length,width-offset),thickness)
    mark.BackgroundColor3=color;mark.ZIndex=z or parent.ZIndex
   end
  end
 end
 return row
end
-- Keyed objects not drawn for a long time (candles trimmed from history) are destroyed.
function Pool:Prune(age)
 local kept={}
 for _,entry in ipairs(self.Objects)do
  if entry.Keyed and not entry.Active and self.Epoch-(entry.Epoch or 0)>age then
   entry.Keyed[entry.Key]=nil self.Entries[entry.Object]=nil self.Moving[entry]=nil self.Parents[entry.Object]=nil
   entry.Object:Destroy()
  else table.insert(kept,entry) end
 end
 -- Children of destroyed objects (e.g. a hollow body's inner fill) go with them.
 local alive={}
 for _,entry in ipairs(kept)do
  if entry.Object.Parent then table.insert(alive,entry) else self.Entries[entry.Object]=nil self.Moving[entry]=nil end
 end
 self.Objects=alive
end
function Pool:Finish()
 if self.Epoch%600==0 then self:Prune(1800) end
 for _,entry in ipairs(self.Objects)do
  if entry.Epoch~=self.Epoch and entry.Active then
   if entry.Gui then entry.Object.Visible=false elseif entry.Stroke then entry.Object.Enabled=false end
   for key,motion in pairs(entry.Motion)do entry.Object[key]=motion.To end
   entry.Active=false table.clear(entry.Motion) self.Moving[entry]=nil
  end
 end
end
return Pool

-- Fixed-size text for labels on cards that lift on hover. TextScaled re-measures against the lifted (UIScale)
-- size and can re-wrap, so these take the largest size up to the label's constraint that fits its box once.
local function fixText(label)
 local constraint=label:FindFirstChild("TypeSize")
 local size=constraint and constraint.MaxTextSize or label.TextSize
 local floor=constraint and constraint.MinTextSize or 8
 local w,h=label.Size.X.Offset,label.Size.Y.Offset
 local function fits(n)
  for line in (label.Text.."\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n")do if TextService:GetTextSize(line,n,label.Font,Vector2.new(1e4,1e4)).X>w then return false end end
  return TextService:GetTextSize(label.Text,n,label.Font,Vector2.new(1e4,1e4)).Y<=h
 end
 while size>floor and not fits(size)do size-=1 end
 label.TextScaled=false;label.TextWrapped=false;label.TextSize=size
 return label
end

 -- Effects queued by replies run after the rebuild they trigger, on the rebuilt controls.
 local queuedEffects={}
 local function locate(path)
  local node=canvas
  for part in path:gmatch("[^%.]+")do node=node and node:FindFirstChild(part)end
  return node
 end
 local function runEffects()
  if not fx or #queuedEffects==0 then return end
  local list=queuedEffects;queuedEffects={}
  for _,e in ipairs(list)do
   local target;for _,path in ipairs(e.Paths)do target=target or locate(path)end
   if target then
    if e.Kind=="Success"then fx:Pulse(target);fx:Ring(target,e.Color or C.Green,14)
    elseif e.Kind=="Error"then fx:Shake(target)
    elseif e.Kind=="Pulse"then fx:Pulse(target)end
   end
  end
 end
 local function effect(paths,kind,color)
  if not fx then return end
  table.insert(queuedEffects,{Paths=paths,Kind=kind,Color=color})
  task.delay(.08,runEffects) -- in case no rebuild follows
 end

 -- One order in flight at a time: BUY/SELL show "Sending" until the server replies (or 6 s pass).
 -- Success feedback only comes from that server reply.
 -- Every order (ticket BUY/SELL and the chart's right-click menu) goes through this one path: the same
 -- client checks, pending state, toasts and server reply handling. The server re-validates everything.
 local function submitOrder(dir,orderType,price,qty,label)
  if s.PendingOrder then toast("Waiting for the previous order's confirmation…","info");return false end
  local paths=dir>0 and tradePaths or sellPaths
  if qty<1 or qty>Market.MaxOrderQuantity or qty%1~=0 then fail("Enter a whole quantity from 1 to "..Market.MaxOrderQuantity..".");effect(paths,"Error");return false end
  for _,field in ipairs({"Stop","Target"})do
   if s[field.."On"]then
    local resolved,err=Market.Protection(Market.Contracts[s.Contract],qty,s[field.."Dollars"])
    if not resolved then fail(err);effect(paths,"Error");return false end
   end
  end
  local max=session:MaxOrder(s.Contract,dir)
  if max and qty>max then
   fail("That's more than your account allows right now. Maximum currently available: "..max.." "..s.Contract..".");effect(paths,"Error");return false
  end
  local ok,msg,tab,requestId=session:Place(s.Contract,dir,qty,orderType,price,s.StopOn and s.StopDollars or nil,s.TargetOn and s.TargetDollars or nil)
  if ok then
   s.Error=nil;s.Tab=orderType=="Market"and tab or"Orders";s.Sheet=false
   local pending={Id=requestId,Direction=dir,At=os.clock()};s.PendingOrder=pending
   if fx then fx:Play("Send")end
   toast("Sending "..(label or(dir>0 and"buy"or"sell").." order").." to the exchange…","info")
   task.delay(6,function()
    if alive and s.PendingOrder==pending then s.PendingOrder=nil;fail("No confirmation from the exchange yet. Check Orders before retrying.")end
   end)
   return true
  else fail(msg);effect(paths,"Error")end
  return false
 end

-- One durable record owns both the checkpoint and its writer lease. UpdateAsync fences stale servers.
local Lease={} Lease.__index=Lease
function Lease.new(store,settings,identity,clock)
 return setmetatable({Store=store,Settings=settings,Identity=identity,Now=clock or os.time,Record=nil,Owned=false},Lease)
end
function Lease:Claim()
 local observed
 local result=self.Store:UpdateAsync(self.Settings.WorldKey,function(old)
  if old then assert(old.Version==1,"Unsupported exchange ownership record")end
  observed=old
  local now=self.Now()
  if old and old.LeaseUntil>now and old.Owner~=self.Identity.Token then return nil end
  local nextRecord=old and table.clone(old)or{Version=1,WorldId=self.Identity.WorldId,Generation=0,SaveSequence=0,SavedStep=0}
  if nextRecord.Owner~=self.Identity.Token then nextRecord.Generation+=1 end
  nextRecord.Owner=self.Identity.Token nextRecord.JobId=self.Identity.JobId nextRecord.PlaceId=self.Identity.PlaceId
  nextRecord.LeaseUntil=now+self.Settings.LeaseSeconds
  return nextRecord
 end)
 self.Record=result or observed
 self.Owned=result~=nil and result.Owner==self.Identity.Token
 return self.Owned,self.Record
end
function Lease:Valid()
 return self.Owned and self.Record~=nil and self.Now()<self.Record.LeaseUntil-self.Settings.SafetySeconds
end
function Lease:Commit(checkpoint,step,release)
 assert(self.Owned and self.Record,"This server does not own the exchange")
 assert(type(checkpoint)=="table"and type(step)=="number","A complete checkpoint is required")
 local generation=self.Record.Generation
 local result=self.Store:UpdateAsync(self.Settings.WorldKey,function(old)
  local now=self.Now()
  if not old or old.Owner~=self.Identity.Token or old.Generation~=generation or old.LeaseUntil<=now or step<old.SavedStep then return nil end
  local nextRecord=table.clone(old)
  nextRecord.Checkpoint=checkpoint nextRecord.SavedStep=step nextRecord.SavedAt=now nextRecord.SaveSequence+=1
  nextRecord.LeaseUntil=release and 0 or now+self.Settings.LeaseSeconds
  if release then nextRecord.Owner="" nextRecord.JobId=""end
  return nextRecord
 end)
 if not result then self.Owned=false;error("Exchange ownership changed; stale checkpoint rejected")end
 self.Record=result self.Owned=not release
 return result
end
return Lease

FX.Sounds={
 Click={Id=17208396156,Volume=.30,Gap=.045,Speed=1.05},  -- Roblox GUI - Select
 Tick={Id=17208396156,Volume=.16,Gap=.04,Speed=1.25},    -- steppers: lighter and shorter
 Select={Id=17208204604,Volume=.24,Gap=.06},             -- Roblox GUI - Bubble: tabs, segments, toggles

  local s=Instance.new("Sound") s.Name=name s.SoundId="rbxassetid://"..spec.Id s.Volume=spec.Volume s.PlaybackSpeed=spec.Speed or 1

function FX:SetSound(enabled,level)
 if enabled~=nil then self.Enabled=enabled==true end
 if level and FX.Levels[level]then self.Level=level end

function FX:Play(name)
 local spec=FX.Sounds[name] local s=self.Instances and self.Instances[name]

 end)
 -- After the whole render: centre, then restore hover or finish a press that caused the rebuild.
 task.defer(function()
  if not b.Parent or not self.Alive then return end
  if not fixed then centre(b)end
  local m=self.Memory[k()]
  if not m then return end
  local recent=m.PressedAt and os.clock()-m.PressedAt<.32
  local hovering=m.Hover and inside(b)
  if not hovering then m.Hover=false end
  if recent and enabled() then

end
-- Debounce: returns true when this activation should be ignored (repeat within `gap`, or disabled).
function FX:Guard(b,gap)
 if b:GetAttribute("Disabled") then return true end
 local m=self:Mem(b:GetFullName()) local now=os.clock()
 if m.ActivatedAt and now-m.ActivatedAt<(gap or .12) then return true end
 m.ActivatedAt=now m.PressedAt=m.PressedAt or now
 return false
end
-- Pops a control when it becomes selected (not when it is merely rebuilt while selected).
function FX:Selected(o,selected)
 if self.Preview or not o.Parent then return end
 local m=self:Mem(o:GetFullName())
 local was=m.Selected m.Selected=selected
 if selected and was==false then
  task.defer(function()
   if not o.Parent then return end
   centre(o) local sc=scaleOf(o) sc.Scale=.9 self:Tween(sc,POP,{Scale=1})
  end)
 end
end
-- A short bump when a displayed value changes (steppers). Frequent market readouts do not use this.
function FX:Bump(o,value)
 if self.Preview or not o.Parent then return end
 local m=self:Mem(o:GetFullName())
 local was=m.Value m.Value=value
 if was~=nil and was~=value then
  local sc=scaleOf(o,"BumpScale") sc.Scale=1.16 self:Tween(sc,BOUNCE,{Scale=1})
 end
end
function FX:Shake(o)
 if self.Preview or not o.Parent then return end
 if o:GetAttribute("FixedGeometry") then self:Ring(o,Color3.fromRGB(255,81,127));return end
 -- Establish the same anchor as Bind before capturing the rest position. A deferred Bind
 -- must never centre a control halfway through a shake and invalidate that saved position.
 centre(o)
 local m=self:Mem(o:GetFullName())
 if m.Shaking then return end m.Shaking=true
 local base=o.Position
 local offsets={-7,6,-4,3,0}
 task.spawn(function()
  for _,dx in ipairs(offsets)do
   if not o.Parent then break end
   local t=TweenService:Create(o,TweenInfo.new(.035,Enum.EasingStyle.Sine),{Position=base+UDim2.fromOffset(dx,0)})
   t:Play() t.Completed:Wait()
  end
  if o.Parent then o.Position=base end
  m.Shaking=false
 end)
end
-- Popup entrance: scale from 90% with a light overshoot and fade the backdrop in.
function FX:Open(dialog,backdrop,fromBottom)
 if self.Preview then return end
 if dialog and dialog.Parent then
  if fromBottom then
   local target=dialog.Position dialog.Position=target+UDim2.fromOffset(0,math.min(80,dialog.AbsoluteSize.Y*.25))
   self:Tween(dialog,TweenInfo.new(.24,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Position=target})
  else
   centre(dialog) local sc=scaleOf(dialog,"PopScale") sc.Scale=.9 self:Tween(sc,POP,{Scale=1})
  end
 end
 if backdrop and backdrop.Parent then
  local t=backdrop.BackgroundTransparency backdrop.BackgroundTransparency=1
  self:Tween(backdrop,TweenInfo.new(.16,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{BackgroundTransparency=t})
 end
end
-- Popup exit: the closed popup is moved out of the canvas (which is about to be rebuilt) into a
-- non-interactive CanvasGroup that fades and shrinks, then is destroyed.
function FX:Ghost(items)
 if self.Preview or not self.Root or #items==0 then for _,o in ipairs(items)do o:Destroy()end return end
 local ghost=Instance.new("CanvasGroup") ghost.Name="PopupGhost" ghost.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1) ghost.BackgroundTransparency=1
 ghost.BorderSizePixel=0 ghost.ZIndex=6 pcall(function()ghost.Interactable=false end)
 ghost.Parent=self.Root
 for _,o in ipairs(items)do
  for _,d in ipairs(o:GetDescendants())do if d:IsA("GuiButton")or d:IsA("TextBox")then d.Active=false pcall(function()d.Interactable=false end)end end
  o.Parent=ghost
  if o.Name~="OverlayBackdrop"and o.Name~="SheetBackdrop"then
   centre(o) self:Tween(scaleOf(o,"PopScale"),TweenInfo.new(.13,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.In),{Scale=.94})
  end
 end
 local t=TweenService:Create(ghost,TweenInfo.new(.13,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.In),{GroupTransparency=1})
 t.Completed:Connect(function()ghost:Destroy()end) t:Play()
 task.delay(.5,function()if ghost.Parent then ghost:Destroy()end end)
end
-- Effects that must outlive a rebuild (success rings) live on a layer above the canvas.
function FX:Layer()
 if self.Preview or not self.Root then return nil end
 local layer=self.Root:FindFirstChild("EffectsLayer")
 if not layer then
  layer=Instance.new("Frame") layer.Name="EffectsLayer" layer.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1) layer.BackgroundTransparency=1
  layer.BorderSizePixel=0 layer.ZIndex=7 layer.Active=false layer.Parent=self.Root
 end
 return layer
end
-- Expanding glow ring around a control's on-screen rectangle.
function FX:Ring(o,color,radius)
 local layer=self:Layer() if not layer or not o or not o.Parent then return end
 local p=o.AbsolutePosition-self.Root.AbsolutePosition local s=o.AbsoluteSize
 local ring=Instance.new("Frame") ring.Name="SuccessRing" ring.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5)
 ring.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(p.X+s.X/2,p.Y+s.Y/2) ring.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(s.X,s.Y)
 ring.BackgroundColor3=color ring.BackgroundTransparency=.7 ring.BorderSizePixel=0 ring.ZIndex=8
 local c=Instance.new("UICorner") c.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,radius or 12) c.Parent=ring
 local st=Instance.new("UIStroke") st.Color=color st.Thickness=3 st.Parent=ring
 ring.Parent=layer
 local info=TweenInfo.new(.5,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
 TweenService:Create(ring,info,{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(s.X+26,s.Y+26),BackgroundTransparency=1}):Play()
 local fade=TweenService:Create(st,info,{Transparency=1}) fade.Completed:Connect(function()ring:Destroy()end) fade:Play()
end
function FX:Pulse(o)
 if self.Preview or not o or not o.Parent then return end
 if o:GetAttribute("FixedGeometry")then self:Ring(o,Color3.fromRGB(46,249,160));return end
 centre(o) local sc=scaleOf(o) sc.Scale=1.07 self:Tween(sc,BOUNCE,{Scale=1})
end
-- Looping decorations (loading dots, coach highlight) are stopped before each rebuild.
function FX:Loop(tween) table.insert(self.Loops,tween) tween:Play() return tween end
function FX:StopLoops() for _,t in ipairs(self.Loops)do t:Cancel()end table.clear(self.Loops) end
function FX:Destroy()
 self.Alive=false self:StopLoops()
 for o,t in pairs(self.Tweens)do t:Cancel()end
 if self.Folder then self.Folder:Destroy() end
 if self.Group then self.Group:Destroy() end
 local layer=self.Root and self.Root:FindFirstChild("EffectsLayer") if layer then layer:Destroy() end
end
return FX
